This investigation illustrates the potential uses of multi-level temporal compression.
zh_title: MTC-VAE：具有内容感知能力的多级时间压缩
translation: 潜在视频扩散模型（LVDMs）依赖变分自编码器（VAEs）将视频压缩成紧凑的潜在表示。对于连续变分自编码器（VAEs）而言，实现更高的压缩率是理想的；然而，在不扩展隐藏通道维度的情况下增加额外的采样层时，效率会显著下降。在本文中，我们提出了一种技术，可以将固定压缩率的VAE转换为支持多级时间压缩的模型，提供了一种简单且最小化的微调方法来抵消在高压缩率下的性能下降。此外，我们研究了不同压缩级别如何影响具有不同特征的视频片段的模型性能，为我们提出的方法的有效性提供了经验证据。我们还研究了将我们的多级时间压缩VAE与基于扩散的生成模型DiT集成，强调了在这些框架内成功的并发训练和兼容性。这项研究说明了多级时间压缩的潜在用途。
tldr: 提出MTC-VAE，一种将固定压缩率变分自编码器（VAE）转换为支持多级时间压缩的技术，旨在通过简单微调在高压缩率下维持效率，并成功地将其与扩散模型（DiT）集成。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了MTC-VAE，它通过引入多级时间压缩机制，解决了传统VAE在追求高压缩率时效率和性能下降的问题。这种方法允许在不显著增加模型复杂性的情况下灵活调整压缩级别，特别适用于需要紧凑潜在表示的潜在视频扩散模型（LVDMs）。将该技术与DiT等主流扩散模型集成并验证其兼容性，凸显了其在视频生成领域的实际应用价值和重要性。
motivation: 潜在视频扩散模型（LVDMs）依赖VAE进行视频压缩。虽然连续VAE需要更高的压缩率，但在不扩展隐藏通道维度的情况下增加采样层会导致效率显著下降，因此需要一种方法在高压缩率下维持效率。
method: 提出MTC-VAE，一种将固定压缩率变分自编码器（VAE）转换为支持多级时间压缩的模型的技术。该方法采用简单且最小化的微调手段，以应对高压缩率下的性能下降。此外，通过检验不同压缩级别对具有不同特征的视频片段的模型性能的影响来提供经验证据。
results: 研究结果提供了经验证据，证明了所提出的多级时间压缩方法的有效性。成功地将MTC-VAE与基于扩散的生成模型DiT集成，并展示了成功的并发训练和兼容性，从而证明了多级时间压缩的潜在用途。

title: Adaptive Quantum-Safe Cryptography for 6G Vehicular Networks via Context-Aware Optimization
authors: Poushali Sengupta, Mayank Raikwar, Sabita Maharjan, Frank Eliassen, Yan Zhang
abstract: Powerful quantum computers in the future may be able to break the security used for communication between vehicles and other devices (Vehicle-to-Everything, or V2X). New security methods called post-quantum cryptography can help protect these systems, but they often require more computing power and can slow down communication, posing a challenge for fast 6G vehicle networks. In this paper, we propose an adaptive post-quantum cryptography (PQC) framework that predicts short-term mobility and channel variations and dynamically selects suitable lattice-, code-, or hash-based PQC configurations using a predictive multi-objective evolutionary algorithm (APMOEA) to meet vehicular latency and security constraints.However, frequent cryptographic reconfiguration in dynamic vehicular environments introduces new attack surfaces during algorithm transitions. A secure monotonic-upgrade protocol prevents downgrade, replay, and desynchronization attacks during transitions. Theoretical results show decision stability under bounded prediction error, latency boundedness under mobility drift, and correctness under small forecast noise. These results demonstrate a practical path toward quantum-safe cryptography in future 6G vehicular networks. Through extensive experiments based on realistic mobility (LuST), weather (ERA5), and NR-V2X channel traces, we show that the proposed framework reduces end-to-end latency by up to 27\%, lowers communication overhead by up to 65\%, and effectively stabilizes cryptographic switching behavior using reinforcement learning. Moreover, under the evaluated adversarial scenarios, the monotonic-upgrade protocol successfully prevents downgrade, replay, and desynchronization attacks.
comment: Accepted for presentation at NDSS 2026 - FutureG Workshop, 23 February 2026. (10 pages, 5 figures.)
zh_title: 通过上下文感知优化实现6G车载网络的自适应量子安全加密
translation: 未来的强大量子计算机可能破坏用于车辆与其他设备（V2X）之间通信的安全性。称为后量子密码学的新安全方法可以帮助保护这些系统，但它们通常需要更多的计算能力并可能减慢通信速度，这对快速的6G车载网络构成了挑战。在本文中，我们提出了一种自适应后量子密码学（PQC）框架，该框架预测短期移动性和信道变化，并使用预测性多目标进化算法（APMOEA）动态选择合适的基于格、编码或哈希的PQC配置，以满足车载网络的延迟和安全约束。然而，在动态车载环境中频繁的密码重新配置会在算法转换期间引入新的攻击面。一个安全的单调升级协议可以防止转换期间的降级、重放和去同步攻击。理论结果显示了在有界预测误差下的决策稳定性、在移动性漂移下的延迟有界性以及在小预测噪声下的正确性。这些结果展示了在未来6G车载网络中实现量子安全加密的实用途径。通过基于现实移动性（LuST）、天气（ERA5）和NR-V2X信道轨迹的广泛实验，我们表明所提出的框架将端到端延迟降低了高达27\%，通信开销降低了高达65\%，并使用强化学习有效稳定了密码切换行为。此外，在评估的对抗场景下，单调升级协议成功防止了降级、重放和去同步攻击。
tldr: 为解决未来量子计算机对V2X的威胁以及PQC的高开销问题，本文提出了一种自适应PQC框架（使用APMOEA预测和选择最佳加密配置）和一个安全的单调升级协议来防止切换攻击。结果显示，该框架显著降低了延迟（27%）和通信开销（65%），并有效保障了切换安全。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将上下文感知优化（通过预测模型和多目标进化算法）应用于后量子密码学配置的动态选择，以克服PQC在资源受限且高速移动的6G V2X环境中的高延迟和高开销挑战。通过引入安全的单调升级协议，它还解决了频繁自适应切换机制中关键但常被忽视的安全漏洞（如降级攻击），为未来量子安全通信在实际车载网络中的部署提供了一个全面且实用的解决方案。
motivation: 未来的强大量子计算机可能破坏用于车辆与其他设备（V2X）之间通信的安全性。现有的后量子密码学（PQC）计算开销大，会减慢通信速度，这对快速的6G车载网络构成了挑战。
method: 提出一个自适应PQC框架，通过预测短期移动性和信道变化，使用预测性多目标进化算法（APMOEA）动态选择合适的基于格、编码或哈希的PQC配置，以满足车载网络的延迟和安全约束。此外，引入了安全的单调升级协议来防止算法转换期间的降级、重放和去同步攻击。
results: 实验结果表明，该框架将端到端延迟降低了高达27%，通信开销降低了高达65%，并使用强化学习有效稳定了密码切换行为。在评估的对抗场景下，单调升级协议成功防止了降级、重放和去同步攻击。理论结果证明了在有界预测误差下的决策稳定性、在移动性漂移下的延迟有界性以及在小预测噪声下的正确性。
conclusion: 这些结果展示了在未来6G车载网络中实现量子安全加密的实用途径。

title: Adaptive Visual Autoregressive Acceleration via Dual-Linkage Entropy Analysis
authors: Yu Zhang, Jingyi Liu, Feng Liu, Duoqian Miao, Qi Zhang, Kexue Fu, Changwei Wang, Longbing Cao
abstract: Visual AutoRegressive modeling (VAR) suffers from substantial computational cost due to the massive token count involved. Failing to account for the continuous evolution of modeling dynamics, existing VAR token reduction methods face three key limitations: heuristic stage partition, non-adaptive schedules, and limited acceleration scope, thereby leaving significant acceleration potential untapped. Since entropy variation intrinsically reflects the transition of predictive uncertainty, it offers a principled measure to capture modeling dynamics evolution. Therefore, we propose NOVA, a training-free token reduction acceleration framework for VAR models via entropy analysis. NOVA adaptively determines the acceleration activation scale during inference by online identifying the inflection point of scale entropy growth. Through scale-linkage and layer-linkage ratio adjustment, NOVA dynamically computes distinct token reduction ratios for each scale and layer, pruning low-entropy tokens while reusing the cache derived from the residuals at the prior scale to accelerate inference and maintain generation quality. Extensive experiments and analyses validate NOVA as a simple yet effective training-free acceleration framework.
zh_title: 基于双链接熵分析的自适应视觉自回归加速
translation: 视觉自回归建模（VAR）由于涉及大量的Token数量而面临巨大的计算成本。现有的VAR Token减少方法未能考虑建模动态的持续演变，面临三个关键局限性：启发式阶段划分、非自适应调度和有限的加速范围，从而未能充分利用显著的加速潜力。由于熵变本质上反映了预测不确定性的转变，它提供了一种原则性的度量方式来捕获建模动态的演变。因此，我们提出了NOVA，一个通过熵分析实现的、用于VAR模型的免训练Token减少加速框架。NOVA通过在线识别尺度熵增长的拐点，在推理过程中自适应地确定加速激活尺度。通过尺度链接和层链接比率调整，NOVA动态计算每个尺度和层的不同Token减少比率，修剪低熵Token，同时重用来自先前尺度残差的缓存来加速推理并保持生成质量。广泛的实验和分析验证了NOVA作为一个简单而有效的免训练加速框架。
tldr: 视觉自回归模型（VAR）因大量Token而计算成本高昂。我们提出了NOVA，一个免训练的框架，它利用熵分析来捕获模型动态，自适应地修剪低熵Token并重用缓存，从而在保持质量的同时显著加速推理。
ai_comments: 创新点在于利用熵分析（一种反映预测不确定性的原理性度量）来动态、自适应地管理VAR模型中的Token减少，解决了现有启发式方法的局限性。NOVA框架是免训练的，这使其具有很高的实用价值，可以轻松应用于现有模型，有效降低因Token数量庞大而产生的高昂计算成本。
motivation: 视觉自回归建模（VAR）因涉及大量Token而计算成本高昂。现有Token减少方法存在启发式阶段划分、非自适应调度和加速范围有限等局限性，未能充分利用加速潜力。
method: 提出了NOVA，一个基于熵分析的免训练Token减少加速框架。NOVA通过在线识别尺度熵增长的拐点来自适应确定加速激活尺度。它通过尺度链接和层链接比率调整，动态计算每个尺度和层的不同Token减少比率，修剪低熵Token，并重用来自先前尺度残差的缓存。
results: 广泛的实验和分析验证了NOVA作为一个简单而有效的免训练加速框架。
conclusion: NOVA是一个简单而有效的免训练加速框架，通过双链接熵分析实现自适应Token减少，从而加速VAR模型并保持生成质量。

title: Model Specific Task Similarity for Vision Language Model Selection via Layer Conductance
authors: Wei Yang, Hong Xie, Tao Tan, Xin Li, Defu Lian, Enhong Chen
abstract: While open sourced Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have proliferated, selecting the optimal pretrained model for a specific downstream task remains challenging. Exhaustive evaluation is often infeasible due to computational constraints and data limitations in few shot scenarios. Existing selection methods fail to fully address this: they either rely on data-intensive proxies or use symmetric textual descriptors that neglect the inherently directional and model-specific nature of transferability. To address this problem, we propose a framework that grounds model selection in the internal functional dynamics of the visual encoder. Our approach represents each task via layer wise conductance and derives a target-conditioned block importance distribution through entropy regularized alignment. Building on this, we introduce Directional Conductance Divergence (DCD), an asymmetric metric that quantifies how effectively a source task covers the target's salient functional blocks. This allows for predicting target model rankings by aggregating source task ranks without direct inference. Experimental results on 48 VLMs across 21 datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving a 14.7% improvement in NDCG@5 over SWAB.
zh_title: 基于层电导的模型特定任务相似性用于视觉语言模型选择
translation: 尽管开源的视觉语言模型（VLMs）激增，但为特定下游任务选择最佳的预训练模型仍然具有挑战性。由于计算限制和少样本场景中的数据限制，详尽的评估往往是不可行的。现有的选择方法未能完全解决这个问题：它们要么依赖于数据密集型代理，要么使用对称的文本描述符，忽略了可迁移性固有的方向性和模型特异性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个框架，将模型选择基于视觉编码器的内部功能动态。我们的方法通过分层电导来表示每个任务，并通过熵正则化对齐来推导目标条件块重要性分布。在此基础上，我们引入了定向电导散度（Directional Conductance Divergence，DCD），这是一个非对称指标，用于量化源任务覆盖目标关键功能块的有效性。这使得无需直接推理即可通过聚合源任务排名来预测目标模型排名。在跨越21个数据集的48个VLM上的实验结果表明，我们的方法优于最先进的基线，在NDCG@5上比SWAB提高了14.7%。
tldr: 针对VLM选择困难的问题，本文提出DCD（定向电导散度）框架，通过分析视觉编码器的内部功能动态（层电导）来衡量任务间的非对称相似性，从而在不进行完整推理的情况下预测模型排名，性能显著优于现有基线。
ai_comments: 这项工作的创新点在于将任务相似性评估从外部数据或文本描述符转移到模型内部的功能动态（层电导），从而捕捉到迁移学习中至关重要的非对称性和模型特异性。DCD作为一种计算高效的评估指标，解决了在大规模VLM选择中详尽评估不可行的问题，对于实际应用和高效利用预训练模型具有重要的价值。它为理解和量化模型内部的知识迁移机制提供了一个新颖且有效的视角。
motivation: 现有的视觉语言模型（VLMs）数量众多，但选择针对特定下游任务的最佳模型具有挑战性。由于计算限制和少样本场景下的数据限制，进行详尽评估往往不可行。现有方法（如数据密集型代理或对称文本描述符）忽略了迁移性的固有方向性和模型特异性。
method: 提出一个将模型选择基于视觉编码器内部功能动态的框架。该方法通过“层电导”表示每个任务，并通过“熵正则化对齐”导出“目标条件块重要性分布”。在此基础上，引入“定向电导散度”（DCD），这是一个非对称指标，用于量化源任务覆盖目标任务关键功能块的有效性。通过聚合源任务排名来预测目标模型排名，无需直接推理。
results: 在跨越21个数据集的48个VLM上的实验结果表明，该方法优于现有最先进的基线，在NDCG@5指标上比SWAB提高了14.7%。

title: Privocracy: Online Democracy through Private Voting
authors: Pedro Camponês, Hugo Pereira, Adrian Persaud, Kevin Gallagher, Santiago Torres-Arias
abstract:
In traditional access control policies, every access granted and administrative account introduces an additional vulnerability, as a corruption of a high-privilege user can compromise several sensitive files. Privocracy is an access control mechanism that minimizes the need to attribute high privileges by triggering a secure e-voting procedure to run commands that require using sensitive resources. With Privocracy an organization can distribute trust in resource access, minimizing the system vulnerabilities from single points of failure, all while maintaining the high flexibility of discretionary access control policies.
  The Privocracy voting mechanism achieves everlasting privacy, ensuring votes remain confidential regardless of an adversary's computational power, while addressing the dependability requirements of a practical and secure system. The procedure incorporates useful features such as vote delegation to reduce voter fatigue, rapid voting rounds to enable quick action during emergencies, and selective vote auditing for application-level accountability. Our experimental results demonstrate that Privocracy processes votes efficiently and can be deployed on commodity hardware.
zh_title: 权限民主制：通过私密投票实现的在线民主
translation: 在传统的访问控制策略中，每次授予的访问和管理员账户都会引入额外的漏洞，因为高权限用户的腐败可能会危及多个敏感文件。权限民主制是一种访问控制机制，它通过触发安全的电子投票程序来运行需要使用敏感资源的命令，从而最大限度地减少归因高权限的需要。通过权限民主制，组织可以在资源访问方面分散信任，最大限度地减少系统来自单点故障的漏洞，同时保持自由裁量访问控制策略的高度灵活性。权限民主制投票机制实现了永久隐私，确保选票的机密性，无论对手的计算能力如何，同时解决了实用且安全的系统的可靠性要求。该程序结合了有用的功能，例如选票委托以减少选民疲劳，快速投票轮次以在紧急情况下实现快速行动，以及用于应用级问责制的选择性选票审计。我们的实验结果表明，权限民主制能够高效地处理选票，并且可以部署在商用硬件上。
tldr: 权限民主制（Privocracy）是一种新的访问控制机制，它用安全的电子投票程序代替传统的高权限账户，从而分散信任、消除单点故障，并实现永久隐私和高效运行。
ai_comments: 这篇论文提出了一种创新的访问控制范式，将传统的信任集中模型（高权限账户）转化为基于共识的“民主”模型（私密投票）。其核心创新在于使用安全的电子投票机制来替代高权限访问，有效地将访问控制问题转化为一个安全的多方计算问题。论文强调的“永久隐私”是其关键优势，意味着即使未来的计算能力大幅提升，投票结果的机密性也能得到保障。此外，系统设计考虑了实际部署的挑战，例如通过“选票委托”来解决用户疲劳问题，以及通过“快速投票轮次”来应对紧急情况，这表明它是一个兼顾理论安全性和实际可用性的设计。
motivation: 传统的访问控制策略中，每次授予的访问和管理员账户都会引入额外的漏洞，因为高权限用户一旦被破坏，可能会危及多个敏感文件，形成单点故障。
method: 权限民主制是一种访问控制机制，它通过触发安全的电子投票程序来运行需要使用敏感资源的命令，从而最大限度地减少归因高权限的需要。该机制实现了永久隐私，确保选票机密性，无论对手的计算能力如何，并满足了实用系统的可靠性要求。它还结合了选票委托（减少选民疲劳）、快速投票轮次（应对紧急情况）和选择性选票审计（应用级问责制）等功能。
results: 实验结果表明，权限民主制能够高效地处理选票，并且可以部署在商用硬件上。

title: Benchmarking of algorithms for set partitions
authors: Arnav Khinvasara, Alexander Pikovski
abstract: Set partitions are arrangements of distinct objects into groups. The problem of listing all set partitions arises in a variety of settings, in particular in combinatorial optimization tasks. After a brief review, we give practical approximate formulas for determining the number of set partitions, both for small and large set sizes. Several algorithms for enumerating all set partitions are reviewed, and benchmarking tests were conducted. The algorithm of Djokic et al. is recommended for practical use.
zh_title: 集合划分算法的基准测试
translation: 集合划分是将不同对象分组的排列方式。列举所有集合划分的问题出现在各种场景中，尤其是在组合优化任务中。在简要回顾之后，我们给出了确定集合划分数量的实用近似公式，适用于小集合和大集合。本文回顾了几种用于列举所有集合划分的算法，并进行了基准测试。推荐将Djokic等人的算法用于实际应用。
tldr: 本文回顾并基准测试了用于列举集合划分的多种算法，提供了计数公式，并推荐了Djokic等人的算法供实际应用。
ai_comments: 本文的重要性在于为集合划分这一基础的组合学问题提供了实用的算法基准测试和性能比较。对于需要高效列举集合划分的组合优化领域的实践者来说，该研究直接推荐了最佳的现有算法（Djokic et al.），具有很高的实用价值。文章的重点在于比较和推荐，而非提出全新的算法。
motivation: 集合划分的列举问题出现在各种场景中，尤其是在组合优化任务中。
method: 首先简要回顾集合划分的概念，然后给出确定集合划分数量的实用近似公式（适用于小集合和大集合），接着回顾了几种用于列举所有集合划分的算法，并进行了基准测试。
results: 提供了确定集合划分数量的实用近似公式（适用于小集合和大集合），并完成了对几种列举算法的基准测试结果。
conclusion: 推荐将Djokic等人的算法用于实际应用。

title: CRAFT: Calibrated Reasoning with Answer-Faithful Traces via Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Hop Question Answering
authors: Yu Liu, Wenxiao Zhang, Cong Cao, Fangfang Yuan, Weizhuo Chen, Cheng Hu, Pin Xu, Yuling Yang, Kun Peng, Diandian Guo, Qiang Sun, Yanbing Liu, Jin B. Hong, Zhiyuan Ma
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is widely used to ground Large Language Models (LLMs) for multi-hop question answering. Recent work mainly focused on improving answer accuracy via fine-tuning and structured or reinforcement-based optimization. However, reliable reasoning in response generation faces three challenges: 1) Reasoning Collapse. Reasoning in multi-hop QA is inherently complex due to multi-hop composition and is further destabilized by noisy retrieval. 2) Reasoning-answer inconsistency. Due to the intrinsic uncertainty of LLM generation and exposure to evidence--distractor mixtures, models may produce correct answers that are not faithfully supported by their intermediate reasoning or evidence. 3) Loss of format control. Traditional chain-of-thought generation often deviates from required structured output formats, leading to incomplete or malformed structured content. To address these challenges, we propose CRAFT (Calibrated Reasoning with Answer-Faithful Traces), a Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) based reinforcement learning framework that trains models to perform faithful reasoning during response generation. CRAFT employs dual reward mechanisms to optimize multi-hop reasoning: deterministic rewards ensure structural correctness while judge-based rewards verify semantic faithfulness. This optimization framework supports controllable trace variants that enable systematic analysis of how structure and scale affect reasoning performance and faithfulness. Experiments on three multi-hop QA benchmarks show that CRAFT improves both answer accuracy and reasoning faithfulness across model scales, with the CRAFT 7B model achieving competitive performance with closed-source LLMs across multiple reasoning trace settings.
zh_title: CRAFT：通过强化学习实现多跳问答中的校准推理与答案忠实轨迹
translation: 检索增强生成（RAG）被广泛用于为多跳问答中的大型语言模型（LLMs）提供事实依据。最近的工作主要通过微调、结构化或基于强化的优化来提高答案准确性。然而，响应生成中可靠的推理面临三个挑战：1) 推理崩溃。多跳问答中的推理本质上是复杂的，多跳组合和嘈杂的检索进一步使其不稳定。2) 推理-答案不一致性。由于LLM生成的内在不确定性以及暴露于证据-干扰项的混合，模型可能会产生正确的答案，但这些答案并未得到其中间推理或证据的忠实支持。3) 格式控制丢失。传统的思维链生成通常偏离所需的结构化输出格式，导致不完整或格式错误的结构化内容。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了CRAFT（Calibrated Reasoning with Answer-Faithful Traces），一个基于群体相对策略优化（GRPO）的强化学习框架，用于训练模型在响应生成过程中执行忠实推理。CRAFT采用双重奖励机制来优化多跳推理：确定性奖励确保结构正确性，而基于判断器的奖励验证语义忠实性。该优化框架支持可控的轨迹变体，从而能够系统地分析结构和规模如何影响推理性能和忠实性。在三个多跳问答基准测试上的实验表明，CRAFT在不同模型规模上均提高了答案准确性和推理忠实性，其中CRAFT 7B模型在多种推理轨迹设置下，取得了与闭源LLMs相当的竞争力。
tldr: 提出了CRAFT，一个基于强化学习（GRPO）的框架，用于解决多跳问答中推理崩溃、推理-答案不一致以及格式控制丢失的问题。CRAFT使用双重奖励机制来优化推理的结构正确性和语义忠实性，显著提高了答案准确性和推理忠实性，其7B模型性能可与闭源LLM媲美。
ai_comments: CRAFT的创新点在于系统地识别并解决了RAG在多跳问答中生成可靠推理的关键问题，特别是“推理-答案不一致性”，这在评估LLM的可靠性时至关重要。通过引入基于GRPO的强化学习和双重奖励机制，它将推理的结构正确性与语义忠实性解耦并同时优化。这种方法不仅提高了准确性，更重要的是，提升了推理过程的可信度（忠实性），为构建更可靠、可解释的LLM推理系统提供了新的范式。
motivation: 现有的RAG方法在多跳问答中面临三个挑战：1) 推理崩溃（由多跳复杂性和噪声检索引起）。2) 推理-答案不一致（模型可能给出正确答案，但中间推理或证据不支持）。3) 格式控制丢失（传统的思维链生成常偏离所需的结构化输出格式）。
method: 提出了CRAFT (Calibrated Reasoning with Answer-Faithful Traces)，一个基于群体相对策略优化（GRPO）的强化学习框架。CRAFT采用双重奖励机制优化多跳推理：确定性奖励确保结构正确性，基于判断器的奖励验证语义忠实性。该框架还支持可控的轨迹变体。
results: 在三个多跳问答基准测试上，CRAFT提高了不同模型规模下的答案准确性和推理忠实性。CRAFT 7B模型在多种推理轨迹设置下，取得了与闭源大型语言模型（LLMs）相当的竞争力。
conclusion: 该强化学习框架（CRAFT）通过解决推理崩溃、不一致和格式控制问题，有效提高了多跳问答中推理的忠实性和答案的准确性，证明了其优越性，并实现了与闭源LLM相当的竞争力。

title: Aggregation Queries over Unstructured Text: Benchmark and Agentic Method
authors: Haojia Zhu, Qinyuan Xu, Haoyu Li, Yuxi Liu, Hanchen Qiu, Jiaoyan Chen, Jiahui Jin
abstract: Aggregation query over free text is a long-standing yet underexplored problem. Unlike ordinary question answering, aggregate queries require exhaustive evidence collection and systems are required to "find all," not merely "find one." Existing paradigms such as Text-to-SQL and Retrieval-Augmented Generation fail to achieve this completeness. In this work, we formalize entity-level aggregation querying over text in a corpus-bounded setting with strict completeness requirement. To enable principled evaluation, we introduce AGGBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate completeness-oriented aggregation under realistic large-scale corpus. To accompany the benchmark, we propose DFA (Disambiguation--Filtering--Aggregation), a modular agentic baseline that decomposes aggregation querying into interpretable stages and exposes key failure modes related to ambiguity, filtering, and aggregation. Empirical results show that DFA consistently improves aggregation evidence coverage over strong RAG and agentic baselines. The data and code are available in https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DFA-A4C1.
zh_title: 非结构化文本上的聚合查询：基准与智能体方法
translation: 对自由文本进行聚合查询是一个长期存在但尚未得到充分探索的问题。与普通问答不同，聚合查询需要详尽的证据收集，系统被要求“找到所有”而非仅仅“找到一个”。现有的范式，如Text-to-SQL和检索增强生成（RAG），无法达到这种完整性要求。在这项工作中，我们形式化了在语料库限制设置下、具有严格完整性要求的实体级文本聚合查询。为了实现原则性的评估，我们引入了AGGBench，这是一个旨在现实大规模语料库下评估完整性导向聚合的基准。为配合该基准，我们提出了DFA（消歧-过滤-聚合）——一个模块化智能体基线，它将聚合查询分解为可解释的阶段，并揭示了与歧义、过滤和聚合相关的关键故障模式。经验结果表明，DFA在聚合证据覆盖率方面始终优于强大的RAG和智能体基线。数据和代码可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DFA-A4C1获取。
tldr: 针对自由文本的聚合查询缺乏完整性，现有方法效果不佳。本文提出了AGGBench基准和DFA（一种模块化智能体方法），后者显著提高了证据覆盖率。
ai_comments: 本文的创新性在于解决了自然语言处理领域中一个关键但被忽视的问题：非结构化文本聚合查询的“完整性”要求，这超越了传统的单答案问答。通过形式化问题并创建AGGBench这一专用基准，为未来的研究提供了标准的评估框架。所提出的DFA模块化智能体方法具有高可解释性，能够明确暴露和解决与歧义、过滤和聚合相关的关键故障模式，这对于复杂文本生成和推理任务的调试具有重要价值。
motivation: 自由文本上的聚合查询是一个长期存在但尚未得到充分探索的问题。与普通问答不同，聚合查询需要详尽的证据收集，要求系统“找到所有”证据，而现有的范式（如Text-to-SQL和RAG）无法满足这种完整性要求。
method: 本文形式化了具有严格完整性要求的语料库限制下的实体级文本聚合查询。随后，引入了AGGBench基准用于评估完整性导向的聚合查询。最后，提出了DFA（消歧-过滤-聚合）模块化智能体基线，它将聚合查询分解为可解释的阶段，并揭示了与歧义、过滤和聚合相关的关键故障模式。
results: 经验结果表明，DFA在聚合证据覆盖率方面始终优于强大的RAG和智能体基线。
conclusion: 本文通过引入AGGBench基准和DFA智能体方法，为解决非结构化文本聚合查询中的完整性问题提供了一种系统化的评估和改进方案，DFA显著提高了证据的覆盖率。

title: DeepPM: A Deep Learning-based Profit Maximization Approach in Social Networks
authors: Poonam Sharma, Suman Banerjee
abstract: The problem of Profit Maximization asks to choose a limited number of influential users from a given social network such that the initial activation of these users maximizes the profit earned at the end of the diffusion process. This problem has a direct impact on viral marketing in social networks. Over the past decade, several traditional methodologies (i.e., non-learning-based, which include approximate solution, heuristic solution, etc.) have been developed, and many of them produce promising results. All these methods require the information diffusion model as input. However, it may not be realistic to consider any particular diffusion model as real-world diffusion scenarios will be much more complex and need not follow the rules for any particular diffusion model. In this paper, we propose a deep learning-based framework to solve the profit maximization problem. Our model makes a latent representation of the seed sets and is able to learn the diversified information diffusion pattern. We also design a noble objective function that can be optimized effectively using the proposed learning-based approach. The proposed model has been evaluated with the real-world datasets, and the results are reported. We compare the effectiveness of the proposed approach with many existing methods and observe that the seed set chosen by the proposed learning-based approach leads to more profit compared to existing methods. The whole implementation and the simulation code is available at: https://github.com/PoonamSharma-PY/DeepPM.
zh_title: DeepPM：一种基于深度学习的社交网络利润最大化方法
translation: 利润最大化问题要求从给定的社交网络中选择有限数量的有影响力的用户，使得这些用户的初始激活能够最大化传播过程结束时获得的利润。这个问题对社交网络中的病毒式营销有直接影响。在过去十年中，已经开发了许多传统方法（即非学习型方法，包括近似解、启发式解等），其中许多方法产生了有希望的结果。所有这些方法都需要信息传播模型作为输入。然而，考虑任何特定的传播模型可能不切实际，因为现实世界的传播场景要复杂得多，并且不需要遵循任何特定传播模型的规则。在本文中，我们提出了一个基于深度学习的框架来解决利润最大化问题。我们的模型对种子集进行了潜在表示，并能够学习多样化的信息传播模式。我们还设计了一个可以使用所提出的基于学习的方法有效优化的新颖目标函数。所提出的模型已使用真实世界数据集进行了评估，并报告了结果。我们将所提出方法的有效性与许多现有方法进行了比较，并观察到所提出的基于学习的方法选择的种子集比现有方法能带来更多的利润。完整的实现和模拟代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/PoonamSharma-PY/DeepPM。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为DeepPM的深度学习模型，用于解决社交网络中的利润最大化问题，它能学习复杂多样的传播模式，无需预设特定的传播模型，并在真实数据集上表现优于现有传统方法。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将利润最大化问题从依赖固定的、可能不准确的传播模型（近似或启发式方法）转向数据驱动的深度学习方法（DeepPM）。这种方法能够自适应地学习现实世界数据中固有的复杂多样的传播模式，从而克服了传统方法对特定传播模型假设的局限性，这对于社交网络中的病毒式营销应用来说是一个重要的进步。
motivation: 现有的利润最大化（PM）方法需要以特定的信息传播模型作为输入，但这在现实世界中不切实际，因为实际的传播场景更加复杂，不一定遵循任何特定模型的规则。
method: 提出了一种名为DeepPM的基于深度学习的框架来解决利润最大化问题。该模型通过对种子集进行潜在表示，学习多样化的信息传播模式，并设计了一个可有效优化的新颖目标函数。
results: 使用真实世界数据集进行评估的结果显示，与许多现有传统方法相比，该学习方法（DeepPM）选择的种子集能带来更高的利润。
conclusion: 提出的基于深度学习的DeepPM方法在社交网络中的利润最大化问题上比现有传统方法更有效，通过选择的种子集能够带来更高的利润。

title: T2M Mamba: Motion Periodicity-Saliency Coupling Approach for Stable Text-Driven Motion Generation
authors: Xingzu Zhan, Chen Xie, Honghang Chen, Yixun Lin, Xiaochun Mai
abstract: Text-to-motion generation, which converts motion language descriptions into coherent 3D human motion sequences, has attracted increasing attention in fields, such as avatar animation and humanoid robotic interaction. Though existing models have achieved significant fidelity, they still suffer from two core limitations: (i) They treat motion periodicity and keyframe saliency as independent factors, overlooking their coupling and causing generation drift in long sequences. (ii) They are fragile to semantically equivalent paraphrases, where minor synonym substitutions distort textual embeddings, propagating through the decoder and producing unstable or erroneous motions. In this work, we propose T2M Mamba to address these limitations by (i) proposing Periodicity-Saliency Aware Mamba, which utilizes novel algorithms for keyframe weight estimation via enhanced Density Peaks Clustering and motion periodicity estimation via FFT-accelerated autocorrelation to capture coupled dynamics with minimal computational overhead, and (ii) constructing a Periodic Differential Cross-modal Alignment Module (PDCAM) to enhance robust alignment of textual and motion embeddings. Extensive experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML datasets have been conducted, confirming the effectiveness of our approach, achieving an FID of 0.068 and consistent gains on all other metrics.
zh_title: T2M Mamba：用于稳定文本驱动运动生成的运动周期性-显著性耦合方法
translation: 文本到运动生成（Text-to-motion generation）是将运动语言描述转换为连贯的3D人体运动序列，该技术在虚拟形象动画和类人机器人交互等领域吸引了越来越多的关注。尽管现有模型已实现了显著的保真度，但它们仍存在两个核心局限性：（一）它们将运动周期性（periodicity）和关键帧显著性（keyframe saliency）视为独立因素，忽略了它们之间的耦合关系，导致长序列中出现生成漂移。（二）它们对语义等效的释义很脆弱，轻微的同义词替换会扭曲文本嵌入，通过解码器传播并产生不稳定或错误的运动。在这项工作中，我们提出了T2M Mamba来解决这些局限性：（一）提出了“周期性-显著性感知Mamba”（Periodicity-Saliency Aware Mamba），它利用增强的密度峰值聚类（Density Peaks Clustering）进行关键帧权重估计，并通过FFT加速的自相关性进行运动周期性估计等新算法，以最小的计算开销捕获耦合动态；（二）构建了“周期性差异跨模态对齐模块”（PDCAM），以增强文本和运动嵌入的鲁棒对齐。在HumanML3D和KIT-ML数据集上进行了广泛实验，证实了我们方法的有效性，实现了0.068的FID，并在所有其他指标上取得了持续的提升。
tldr: T2M Mamba提出了一种运动周期性-显著性耦合方法，结合Mamba架构和PDCAM模块，解决了长序列运动生成中的漂移问题以及对文本释义的脆弱性，实现了更稳定的文本驱动运动生成。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于明确建模了运动的“周期性”与“显著性”之间的耦合关系，这对于生成自然、连贯的长序列人体运动至关重要。通过利用Mamba架构（一种状态空间模型SSM）来处理长序列，暗示了其旨在解决传统Transformer模型在处理长序列时易发生的“生成漂移”问题。此外，通过PDCAM模块增强对文本释义的鲁棒性，解决了跨模态生成中的一个关键实际限制，提高了模型的实用性。
motivation: 现有文本到运动生成模型存在两大核心局限性：（一）忽略了运动周期性与关键帧显著性之间的耦合关系，导致长序列中出现生成漂移。（二）对语义等效的释义缺乏鲁棒性，轻微的同义词替换会导致不稳定或错误的运动。
method: 提出了T2M Mamba模型。方法包括：（一）提出了“周期性-显著性感知Mamba”（Periodicity-Saliency Aware Mamba），利用增强的密度峰值聚类（Density Peaks Clustering）进行关键帧权重估计，并通过FFT加速的自相关性进行运动周期性估计，以最小的计算开销捕获耦合动态。（二）构建了“周期性差异跨模态对齐模块”（PDCAM），以增强文本和运动嵌入的鲁棒对齐。
results: 在HumanML3D和KIT-ML数据集上进行了广泛实验，证实了方法的有效性，实现了0.068的FID，并在所有其他指标上取得了持续的提升。
conclusion: T2M Mamba通过耦合运动周期性和显著性信息以及增强鲁棒的跨模态对齐，成功解决了长序列生成漂移和对文本释义脆弱性的限制，实现了稳定且高质量的文本驱动运动生成。

title: Breaking the Temporal Complexity Barrier: Bucket Calculus for Parallel Machine Scheduling
authors: Noor Islam S. Mohammad
abstract: This paper introduces bucket calculus, a novel mathematical framework that fundamentally transforms the computational complexity landscape of parallel machine scheduling optimization. We address the strongly NP-hard problem $P2|r_j|C_{\max}$ through an innovative adaptive temporal discretization methodology that achieves exponential complexity reduction from $O(T^n)$ to $O(B^n)$ where $B \ll T$, while maintaining near-optimal solution quality. Our bucket-indexed mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) formulation exploits dimensional complexity heterogeneity through precision-aware discretization, reducing decision variables by 94.4\% and achieving a theoretical speedup factor $2.75 \times 10^{37}$ for 20-job instances. Theoretical contributions include partial discretization theory, fractional bucket calculus operators, and quantum-inspired mechanisms for temporal constraint modeling. Empirical validation on instances with 20--400 jobs demonstrates 97.6\% resource utilization, near-perfect load balancing ($σ/μ= 0.006$), and sustained performance across problem scales with optimality gaps below 5.1\%. This work represents a paradigm shift from fine-grained temporal discretization to multi-resolution precision allocation, bridging the fundamental gap between exact optimization and computational tractability for industrial-scale NP-hard scheduling problems.
zh_title: 打破时间复杂度障碍：桶微积分用于并行机调度
translation: 本文介绍了一种新颖的数学框架“桶微积分”，它从根本上改变了并行机调度优化问题的计算复杂性格局。我们通过一种创新的自适应时间离散化方法解决了强NP-hard问题P2|r_j|C_max，该方法实现了从O(T^n)到O(B^n)的指数级复杂度降低，其中B « T，同时保持了接近最优的解。我们的桶索引混合整数线性规划（MILP）公式通过精度感知离散化利用了维度复杂度的异质性，将决策变量减少了94.4%，并为20个作业实例实现了理论上的2.75×10^37倍加速因子。理论贡献包括部分离散化理论、分数桶微积分算子以及用于时间约束建模的量子启发机制。在具有20--400个作业的实例上的经验验证显示，资源利用率为97.6%，接近完美的负载均衡（σ/μ=0.006），并且在问题规模上保持了持续的性能，最优性差距低于5.1%。这项工作代表了一种从细粒度时间离散化到多分辨率精度分配的范式转变，弥合了精确优化与工业规模NP-hard调度问题的计算可行性之间的根本差距。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为“桶微积分”的新框架，用于解决NP-hard的并行机调度问题P2|r_j|C_max。通过一种自适应时间离散化方法，将复杂度从O(T^n)降低到O(B^n)，并保持了接近最优的解。该方法通过桶索引的混合整数线性规划（MILP）公式，减少了94.4%的决策变量，并实现了理论上的2.75×10^37倍加速。研究还包括了部分离散化理论、分数桶微积分算子和量子启发的时序约束建模机制。实验表明，该方法在资源利用率、负载均衡和最优性差距方面表现出色，为工业级NP-hard调度问题提供了从精确优化到计算可行性的新范式。
ai_comments: 该研究通过引入“桶微积分”框架，在解决NP-hard并行机调度问题方面取得了显著的理论和实践突破。其核心创新在于通过时间离散化技术大幅降低了计算复杂度，并结合MILP实现了高效求解。实验结果令人印象深刻，尤其是在资源利用率和负载均衡方面。该方法有望为工业级调度问题的优化提供新的解决方案。然而，文中提到的“量子启发机制”的具体实现和优势有待进一步阐述。
motivation: 解决强NP-hard问题P2|r_j|C_max，并打破其时间复杂度障碍。
method: 提出了一种名为“桶微积分”的新数学框架，采用创新的自适应时间离散化方法，利用桶索引的混合整数线性规划（MILP）公式，并结合了部分离散化理论、分数桶微积分算子和量子启发的时序约束建模机制。
results: 将复杂度从O(T^n)降低到O(B^n)，决策变量减少94.4%，理论加速因子为2.75×10^37。实验结果显示资源利用率为97.6%，负载均衡度（σ/μ）为0.006，最优性差距低于5.1%。
conclusion: 该工作代表了一种从细粒度时间离散化到多分辨率精度分配的范式转变，弥合了精确优化与工业规模NP-hard调度问题的计算可行性之间的根本差距。

title: Your Self-Play Algorithm is Secretly an Adversarial Imitator: Understanding LLM Self-Play through the Lens of Imitation Learning
authors: Shangzhe Li, Xuchao Zhang, Chetan Bansal, Weitong Zhang
abstract: Self-play post-training methods has emerged as an effective approach for finetuning large language models and turn the weak language model into strong language model without preference data. However, the theoretical foundations for self-play finetuning remain underexplored. In this work, we tackle this by connecting self-play finetuning with adversarial imitation learning by formulating finetuning procedure as a min-max game between the model and a regularized implicit reward player parameterized by the model itself. This perspective unifies self-play imitation and general preference alignment within a common framework. Under this formulation, we present a game-theoretic analysis showing that the self-play finetuning will converge to it's equilibrium. Guided by this theoretical formulation, we propose a new self-play imitation finetuning algorithm based on the $χ^2$-divergence variational objective with bounded rewards and improved stability. Experiments on various of language model finetuning tasks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing self-play methods and validate our theoretical insights.
zh_title: 你的自博弈算法秘密地是一个对抗模仿者：通过模仿学习的视角理解大语言模型自博弈
translation: 自博弈后训练方法已成为一种有效的微调大语言模型的方法，能够在没有偏好数据的情况下将弱语言模型转化为强语言模型。然而，自博弈微调的理论基础尚未得到充分探索。在这项工作中，我们通过将微调过程表述为模型与一个由模型自身参数化的正则化隐式奖励参与者之间的最小最大博弈，从而将自博弈微调与对抗模仿学习联系起来解决这一问题。这一视角将自博弈模仿和通用偏好对齐统一在一个共同的框架内。在此公式下，我们提出了一个博弈论分析，表明自博弈微调将收敛到其均衡点。受此理论公式的指导，我们提出了一种新的自博弈模仿微调算法，该算法基于$\chi^2$散度变分目标，具有有界奖励和更高的稳定性。在各种语言模型微调任务上的实验证明，该方法比现有的自博弈方法有持续的改进，并验证了我们的理论见解。
tldr: LLM自博弈微调本质上是一种对抗模仿学习。我们将其形式化为一个最小最大博弈，证明了收敛性，并基于$\chi^2$散度提出了一种新的、更优越的自博弈算法。
ai_comments: 本文的主要创新在于为高度经验化的LLM自博弈微调方法提供了一个坚实的理论基础——将其重新定义为对抗模仿学习和最小最大博弈。这种理论视角不仅解释了自博弈的有效性，还指导了新算法（基于$χ^2$散度）的设计，提高了稳定性和性能。将自博弈模仿与通用偏好对齐统一在一个框架内，具有重要的理论意义。
motivation: 自博弈后训练方法在缺乏偏好数据的情况下能有效地将弱语言模型微调成强语言模型，但其理论基础尚未得到充分探索。
method: 将自博弈微调与对抗模仿学习联系起来，将其表述为一个模型与正则化隐式奖励参与者（由模型自身参数化）之间的最小最大博弈。基于此理论公式，提出了一种新的、基于$\chi^2$散度变分目标、具有有界奖励和更高稳定性的自博弈模仿微调算法。
results: 在各种大语言模型微调任务上的实验表明，该方法比现有的自博弈方法有持续的改进，并验证了其理论见解。
conclusion: 通过将自博弈微调与对抗模仿学习相连接，为自博弈算法提供了一个统一的理论框架，并基于此提出了一个更稳定且性能优于现有方法的自博弈模仿微调算法。

title: PaAno: Patch-Based Representation Learning for Time-Series Anomaly Detection
authors: Jinju Park, Seokho Kang
abstract: Although recent studies on time-series anomaly detection have increasingly adopted ever-larger neural network architectures such as transformers and foundation models, they incur high computational costs and memory usage, making them impractical for real-time and resource-constrained scenarios. Moreover, they often fail to demonstrate significant performance gains over simpler methods under rigorous evaluation protocols. In this study, we propose Patch-based representation learning for time-series Anomaly detection (PaAno), a lightweight yet effective method for fast and efficient time-series anomaly detection. PaAno extracts short temporal patches from time-series training data and uses a 1D convolutional neural network to embed each patch into a vector representation. The model is trained using a combination of triplet loss and pretext loss to ensure the embeddings capture informative temporal patterns from input patches. During inference, the anomaly score at each time step is computed by comparing the embeddings of its surrounding patches to those of normal patches extracted from the training time-series. Evaluated on the TSB-AD benchmark, PaAno achieved state-of-the-art performance, significantly outperforming existing methods, including those based on heavy architectures, on both univariate and multivariate time-series anomaly detection across various range-wise and point-wise performance measures.
comment: Accepted by the 14th International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR 2026)
zh_title: 基于块的表示学习用于时间序列异常检测
translation: 尽管时间序列异常检测的近期研究越来越多地采用变换器和基础模型等日益庞大的神经网络架构，但它们会带来高昂的计算成本和内存使用量，使其不适用于实时和资源受限的场景。此外，它们在严格的评估协议下往往无法显示出比简单方法显著的性能提升。在本研究中，我们提出了PaAno（Patch-based representation learning for time-series Anomaly detection），一种轻量级但有效的方法，用于快速高效的时间序列异常检测。PaAno从时间序列训练数据中提取短时块，并使用一维卷积神经网络将每个块嵌入为向量表示。该模型结合了三元组损失和代理任务损失进行训练，以确保嵌入捕捉输入块中有信息量的时间模式。在推理过程中，通过将周围块的嵌入与从训练时间序列中提取的正常块的嵌入进行比较来计算每个时间步的异常分数。在TSB-AD基准测试上进行评估，PaAno取得了最先进的性能，在单变量和多变量时间序列异常检测的各种范围和点度量上，显著优于包括基于重型架构的方法在内的现有方法。
tldr: PaAno是一种轻量级的时间序列异常检测方法，通过学习时间块的表示来有效检测异常，并在TSB-AD基准测试中取得了最先进的性能。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种名为PaAno的轻量级时间序列异常检测方法，旨在解决现有大型模型计算成本高、内存占用大的问题。PaAno通过提取时间块并学习其嵌入表示来捕捉时间模式，并在TSB-AD基准测试中取得了优于现有方法的性能。该方法的创新之处在于其轻量级设计和在实际应用场景中的有效性。然而，文章未详细说明其在不同类型异常（如点异常、上下文异常）上的具体表现，以及在更复杂或噪声较大的数据集上的鲁棒性。
motivation: 大型神经网络模型在时间序列异常检测中计算成本高、内存占用大，不适用于实时和资源受限场景，且性能提升不明显。PaAno旨在提供一种轻量级、高效的方法。
method: PaAno提取时间序列数据的短时块，使用一维卷积神经网络将每个块嵌入为向量表示。模型结合三元组损失和代理任务损失进行训练，以捕捉有意义的时间模式。在推理时，通过比较周围块的嵌入与正常块的嵌入来计算异常分数。
results: PaAno在TSB-AD基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，显著优于包括基于大型架构的方法在内的现有方法，在单变量和多变量时间序列异常检测的各种范围和点度量上均表现出色。
conclusion: PaAno是一种轻量级且有效的时间序列异常检测方法，能够快速高效地检测异常，并在各种基准测试中实现了最先进的性能，证明了其在实际应用中的潜力。

title: Causally Disentangled Contrastive Learning for Multilingual Speaker Embeddings
authors: Mariëtte Olijslager, Seyed Sahand Mohammadi Ziabari, Ali Mohammed Mansoor Alsahag
abstract: Self-supervised speaker embeddings are widely used in speaker verification systems, but prior work has shown that they often encode sensitive demographic attributes, raising fairness and privacy concerns. This paper investigates the extent to which demographic information, specifically gender, age, and accent, is present in SimCLR-trained speaker embeddings and whether such leakage can be mitigated without severely degrading speaker verification performance. We study two debiasing strategies: adversarial training through gradient reversal and a causal bottleneck architecture that explicitly separates demographic and residual information. Demographic leakage is quantified using both linear and nonlinear probing classifiers, while speaker verification performance is evaluated using ROC-AUC and EER. Our results show that gender information is strongly and linearly encoded in baseline embeddings, whereas age and accent are weaker and primarily nonlinearly represented. Adversarial debiasing reduces gender leakage but has limited effect on age and accent and introduces a clear trade-off with verification accuracy. The causal bottleneck further suppresses demographic information, particularly in the residual representation, but incurs substantial performance degradation. These findings highlight fundamental limitations in mitigating demographic leakage in self-supervised speaker embeddings and clarify the trade-offs inherent in current debiasing approaches.
zh_title: 多语言说话人嵌入因果解缠的对比学习
translation: 自监督说话人嵌入被广泛应用于说话人验证系统，但先前的研究表明它们常常编码敏感的人口统计学属性，引发了公平性和隐私问题。本研究探究了SimCLR训练的说话人嵌入中包含性别、年龄和口音信息的程度，以及在不严重损害说话人验证性能的情况下减轻这种泄露的可能性。我们研究了两种去偏策略：通过梯度反转进行的对抗性训练和一种明确分离人口统计学与残差信息的因果瓶颈架构。使用线性和非线性探测分类器量化人口统计学信息的泄露，并使用ROC-AUC和EER评估说话人验证性能。我们的结果表明，性别信息在基线嵌入中被强线性编码，而年龄和口音信息则较弱且主要以非线性方式表示。对抗性去偏减少了性别信息泄露，但对年龄和口音效果有限，并引入了与验证精度的明显权衡。因果瓶颈架构进一步抑制了人口统计学信息（尤其是在残差表示中），但导致了显著的性能下降。这些发现凸显了在自监督说话人嵌入中减轻人口统计学信息泄露的根本性限制，并阐明了当前去偏方法固有的权衡。
tldr: 本研究评估了SimCLR训练的说话人嵌入中包含的性别、年龄和口音信息，并尝试通过对抗性训练和因果瓶颈两种方法减少这些敏感信息的泄露，同时尽量不影响说话人验证的性能。结果表明，性别信息易于泄露且与验证性能有直接权衡，而年龄和口音信息泄露较少且难以去除。因果瓶颈方法能更有效地去除敏感信息，但会严重影响验证性能。研究揭示了在自监督说话人嵌入中消除敏感信息泄露的根本性限制以及现有方法的权衡。
ai_comments: 这项研究对于理解和改进说话人识别系统的公平性和隐私保护具有重要意义。研究方法清晰，通过对比实验验证了不同去偏策略的效果和局限性。然而，因果瓶颈方法虽然能有效去除敏感信息，但其对性能的显著影响表明，在实际应用中需要在隐私和性能之间做出艰难的权衡。未来的研究可以探索更精细的解耦方法，或者在数据层面进行干预，以期在保持高性能的同时最大限度地减少敏感信息的泄露。
motivation: 现有的自监督说话人嵌入技术常常会泄露性别、年龄和口音等敏感人口统计学信息，引发公平性和隐私问题。本研究旨在探究这些信息在SimCLR训练的嵌入中的存在程度，并评估两种去偏策略（对抗性训练和因果瓶颈）在不严重损害说话人验证性能的前提下减轻这种信息泄露的可行性。
method: 研究了两种去偏策略：1. 通过梯度反转进行对抗性训练；2. 采用因果瓶颈架构，显式分离人口统计学信息和残差信息。使用线性/非线性探测分类器量化人口统计学信息的泄露程度，并使用ROC-AUC和EER评估说话人验证性能。
results: 性别信息在基线嵌入中被强线性编码；年龄和口音信息则较弱且主要以非线性方式表示。对抗性去偏能减少性别信息泄露，但对年龄和口音效果有限，并导致验证精度下降。因果瓶颈架构能进一步抑制人口统计学信息（尤其在残差表示中），但会造成显著的性能下降。
conclusion: 研究结果表明，在自监督说话人嵌入中消除人口统计学信息泄露存在根本性限制，并且当前的去偏方法在信息消除和验证性能之间存在固有的权衡。特别是性别信息泄露严重，且与其验证性能存在直接的权衡关系。

title: Deep Variational Contrastive Learning for Joint Risk Stratification and Time-to-Event Estimation
authors: Pinar Erbil, Alberto Archetti, Eugenio Lomurno, Matteo Matteucci
abstract: Survival analysis is essential for clinical decision-making, as it allows practitioners to estimate time-to-event outcomes, stratify patient risk profiles, and guide treatment planning. Deep learning has revolutionized this field with unprecedented predictive capabilities but faces a fundamental trade-off between performance and interpretability. While neural networks achieve high accuracy, their black-box nature limits clinical adoption. Conversely, deep clustering-based methods that stratify patients into interpretable risk groups typically sacrifice predictive power. We propose CONVERSE (CONtrastive Variational Ensemble for Risk Stratification and Estimation), a deep survival model that bridges this gap by unifying variational autoencoders with contrastive learning for interpretable risk stratification. CONVERSE combines variational embeddings with multiple intra- and inter-cluster contrastive losses. Self-paced learning progressively incorporates samples from easy to hard, improving training stability. The model supports cluster-specific survival heads, enabling accurate ensemble predictions. Comprehensive evaluation on four benchmark datasets demonstrates that CONVERSE achieves competitive or superior performance compared to existing deep survival methods, while maintaining meaningful patient stratification.
zh_title: 用于联合风险分层和时间至事件估计的深度变分对比学习
translation: 生存分析对于临床决策至关重要，因为它允许从业者估计时间至事件结果、对患者风险概况进行分层以及指导治疗计划。深度学习以其前所未有的预测能力彻底改变了这一领域，但面临性能和可解释性之间的根本权衡。虽然神经网络可以实现高精度，但其黑箱特性限制了临床应用。相反，基于深度聚类的方法对患者进行可解释的风险组分层，但通常会牺牲预测能力。我们提出了 CONVERSE（用于风险分层和估计的对比变分集成），一个弥合这一差距的深度生存模型，它通过将变分自编码器与对比学习相结合来实现可解释的风险分层。CONVERSE 结合了变分嵌入与多个类内和类间对比损失。自步学习逐步纳入从易到难的样本，提高了训练稳定性。该模型支持特定于簇的生存头，从而实现准确的集成预测。在四个基准数据集上的全面评估表明，与现有深度生存方法相比，CONVERSE 实现了具有竞争性或更优的性能，同时保持了有意义的患者分层。
tldr: CONVERSE 模型使用变分自编码器和对比学习，通过巧妙的损失函数和训练策略，实现了高精度的生存预测和可解释的风险分层，解决了深度学习在临床应用中的“黑箱”问题。
ai_comments: 该模型通过结合变分自编码器和对比学习，成功地在保持模型可解释性的同时，实现了与现有深度生存模型相当或更优的预测性能，解决了性能与可解释性之间的权衡问题。自步学习策略是其稳定性的一个关键点。
motivation: 深度学习在生存分析中性能强大但缺乏可解释性，而基于深度聚类的方法虽然可解释但牺牲了预测能力。因此，需要一个能弥合性能和可解释性之间差距的模型。
method: 提出 CONVERSE（CONtrastive Variational Ensemble for Risk Stratification and Estimation），一个结合了变分自编码器和对比学习的深度生存模型，用于可解释的风险分层。它使用多个类内和类间对比损失，并采用自步学习策略逐步纳入样本，支持特定于簇的生存头以进行集成预测。
results: 在四个基准数据集上，CONVERSE 实现了与现有深度生存方法相比具有竞争性或更优的性能，同时保持了有意义的患者分层。
conclusion: CONVERSE 在四个基准数据集上实现了具有竞争性或优于现有深度生存方法的性能，同时保持了有意义的患者分层。

title: When Domains Interact: Asymmetric and Order-Sensitive Cross-Domain Effects in Reinforcement Learning for Reasoning
authors: Wang Yang, Shouren Wang, Chaoda Song, Chuang Ma, Xinpeng Li, Nengbo Wang, Kaixiong Zhou, Vipin Chaudhary, Xiaotian Han
abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has become a key technique for improving reasoning abilities in large language models, yet its behavior under different domain sequencing strategies is poorly understood. In particular, the impact of sequential (one domain at a time) versus mixed-domain (multiple domain at a time) training in GRPO has not been systematically studied. We provide the first systematic analysis of training-order effects across math, science, logic, and puzzle reasoning tasks. We found (1) single-domain generalization is highly asymmetric: training on other domains improves math reasoning by approximately 25\% accuracy, while yielding negligible transfer to logic and puzzle; (2) cross-domain interactions are highly order-dependent: training in the order math$\rightarrow$science achieves 83\% / 41\% accuracy on math / science, while reversing the order to science$\rightarrow$math degrades performance to 77\% / 25\%; (3) no single strategy is universally optimal in multi-domain training: sequential training favors math (up to 84\%), mixed training favors science and logic, and poor ordering can incur large performance gaps (from 70\% to 56\%). Overall, our findings demonstrate that GRPO under multi-domain settings exhibits pronounced asymmetry, order sensitivity, and strategy dependence, highlighting the necessity of domain-aware and order-aware training design.
zh_title: 当领域相互作用时：强化学习中用于推理的不对称且顺序敏感的跨域效应
translation: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)已成为提高大型语言模型推理能力的关键技术，但其在不同领域排序策略下的行为尚未得到充分理解。特别是，GRPO中顺序（一次一个领域）与混合领域（一次多个领域）训练的影响尚未得到系统研究。我们首次系统分析了数学、科学、逻辑和谜题推理任务中的训练顺序效应。我们发现（1）单领域泛化高度不对称：在其他领域训练可使数学推理准确率提高约25%，但对逻辑和谜题的迁移效果可忽略不计；（2）跨域交互高度依赖顺序：按Math$\rightarrow$Science顺序训练可达到 83% / 41% 的数学/科学准确率，而反转顺序至Science$\rightarrow$Math则性能降至 77% / 25%；（3）在多领域训练中没有单一的通用最优策略：顺序训练偏向数学（高达84%），混合训练偏向科学和逻辑，不良的顺序可能导致巨大的性能差距（从70%到56%）。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，GRPO在多领域设置下表现出明显的非对称性、顺序敏感性和策略依赖性，突显了领域感知和顺序感知的训练设计的必要性。
tldr: GRPO在多领域推理训练中，训练顺序对性能影响巨大且结果高度不对称，顺序和领域选择是关键的、需要仔细设计的因素。
ai_comments: 这项研究首次系统分析了GRPO在不同领域训练顺序下的表现，揭示了跨域学习中存在显著的非对称性、顺序依赖性和策略依赖性，强调了设计领域感知和顺序感知的训练策略的必要性。方法论是系统性分析，创新点在于首次量化了顺序对性能的负面影响。
motivation: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)是提高大型语言模型推理能力的关键技术，但其在不同领域排序策略下的行为（顺序训练与混合训练）尚未得到系统研究。
method: 对数学、科学、逻辑和谜题推理任务进行系统的、不同训练顺序（顺序训练 vs. 混合训练）下的Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)分析。
results: (1) 单领域泛化高度不对称：其他领域训练对数学推理提高约25%准确率，但对逻辑和谜题的迁移效果可忽略不计；(2) 跨域交互高度依赖顺序：Math$\rightarrow$Science 顺序达到 83%/41% 准确率，而 Science$\rightarrow$Math 降至 77%/25%；(3) 无单一最优策略：顺序训练偏向数学，混合训练偏向科学和逻辑，不良顺序可能导致性能出现巨大差距（从 70% 到 56%）。
conclusion: GRPO在多领域设置下表现出明显的非对称性、顺序敏感性和策略依赖性，突显了领域感知和顺序感知的训练设计是必要的。

title: Balancing Understanding and Generation in Discrete Diffusion Models
authors: Yue Liu, Yuzhong Zhao, Zheyong Xie, Qixiang Ye, Jianbin Jiao, Yao Hu, Shaosheng Cao, Yunfan Liu
abstract: In discrete generative modeling, two dominant paradigms demonstrate divergent capabilities: Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLM) excel at semantic understanding and zero-shot generalization, whereas Uniform-noise Diffusion Language Models (UDLM) achieve strong few-step generation quality, yet neither attains balanced performance across both dimensions. To address this, we propose XDLM, which bridges the two paradigms via a stationary noise kernel. XDLM offers two key contributions: (1) it provides a principled theoretical unification of MDLM and UDLM, recovering each paradigm as a special case; and (2) an alleviated memory bottleneck enabled by an algebraic simplification of the posterior probabilities. Experiments demonstrate that XDLM advances the Pareto frontier between understanding capability and generation quality. Quantitatively, XDLM surpasses UDLM by 5.4 points on zero-shot text benchmarks and outperforms MDLM in few-step image generation (FID 54.1 vs. 80.8). When scaled to tune an 8B-parameter large language model, XDLM achieves 15.0 MBPP in just 32 steps, effectively doubling the baseline performance. Finally, analysis of training dynamics reveals XDLM's superior potential for long-term scaling. Code is available at https://github.com/MzeroMiko/XDLM
comment: 32 pages, Code is available at https://github.com/MzeroMiko/XDLM
zh_title: 平衡离散扩散模型中的理解与生成能力
translation: 在离散生成建模中，两种主导范式展现出不同的能力：掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）擅长语义理解和零样本泛化，而均匀噪声扩散语言模型（UDLM）实现了强大的少步数生成质量。然而，两者都无法在这两个维度上实现平衡的性能。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了XDLM，它通过一个平稳噪声核来连接这两种范式。XDLM提供了两个关键贡献：（1）它提供了MDLM和UDLM的原则性理论统一，将每种范式作为特例恢复；（2）通过对后验概率进行代数简化，减轻了内存瓶颈。实验证明，XDLM推进了理解能力和生成质量之间的帕累托前沿。定量上，XDLM在零样本文本基准测试中超越UDLM 5.4分，并在少步数图像生成中优于MDLM（FID 54.1 vs. 80.8）。当扩展到调整一个80亿参数的大型语言模型时，XDLM在短短32步内实现了15.0 MBPP，有效地使基线性能翻倍。最后，对训练动态的分析揭示了XDLM在长期扩展方面具有优越的潜力。代码可在https://github.com/MzeroMiko/XDLM获取。
tldr: XDLM是一种新型离散扩散模型，通过平稳噪声核统一了MDLM和UDLM，解决了现有模型理解与生成能力不平衡的问题。它还通过代数简化缓解了内存瓶颈，在零样本文本理解和少步数图像生成任务中均显著超越了现有基线。
ai_comments: 本文的核心创新在于通过引入平稳噪声核，实现了两种主要离散扩散模型范式（MDLM和UDLM）的理论统一。这种统一使XDLM能够平衡地继承两者的优势，即强大的语义理解能力和高质量、快速的生成能力，这是离散生成建模领域的重要进展。通过代数简化缓解内存瓶颈，对于模型的大规模应用具有实际意义。特别是在LLM微调任务中，XDLM在少步数内实现了性能翻倍，证明了其在实际应用中的高效性和潜力。
motivation: 现有离散生成模型（如MDLM和UDLM）的能力是分散的：MDLM擅长语义理解和零样本泛化，而UDLM擅长少步数生成质量。但两者都无法在这两个维度上实现平衡的性能。
method: 提出了XDLM模型，通过引入平稳噪声核来连接MDLM和UDLM这两种范式。该方法在理论上统一了两种模型，并将它们作为特例恢复；同时，通过对后验概率进行代数简化，减轻了模型的内存瓶颈。
results: XDLM推进了理解能力和生成质量之间的帕累托前沿。定量结果显示：在零样本文本基准测试中，XDLM超越UDLM 5.4分；在少步数图像生成中，XDLM（FID 54.1）优于MDLM（FID 80.8）。在80亿参数的大型语言模型上，XDLM在32步内实现了15.0 MBPP，性能是基线的两倍。训练动态分析显示XDLM具有更优越的长期扩展潜力。
conclusion: XDLM成功地平衡了离散扩散模型中的理解能力和生成质量，推进了性能的帕累托前沿，并显示出优越的长期扩展潜力。

title: PolyGen: Fully Synthetic Vision-Language Training via Multi-Generator Ensembles
authors: Leonardo Brusini, Cristian Sbrolli, Eugenio Lomurno, Toshihiko Yamasaki, Matteo Matteucci
abstract: Synthetic data offers a scalable solution for vision-language pre-training, yet current state-of-the-art methods typically rely on scaling up a single generative backbone, which introduces generator-specific spectral biases and limits feature diversity. In this work, we introduce PolyGen, a framework that redefines synthetic data construction by prioritizing manifold coverage and compositional rigor over simple dataset size. PolyGen employs a Polylithic approach to train on the intersection of architecturally distinct generators, effectively marginalizing out model-specific artifacts. Additionally, we introduce a Programmatic Hard Negative curriculum that enforces fine-grained syntactic understanding. By structurally reallocating the same data budget from unique captions to multi-source variations, PolyGen achieves a more robust feature space, outperforming the leading single-source baseline (SynthCLIP) by +19.0% on aggregate multi-task benchmarks and on the SugarCrepe++ compositionality benchmark (+9.1%). These results demonstrate that structural diversity is a more data-efficient scaling law than simply increasing the volume of single-source samples.
zh_title: 全合成视觉-语言训练通过多生成器集成
translation: 合成数据为视觉-语言预训练提供了一种可扩展的解决方案，然而，当前最先进的方法通常依赖于扩展单个生成主干，这会引入生成器特有的频谱偏差并限制特征多样性。在本研究中，我们引入了PolyGen，一个重新定义合成数据构建的框架，它优先考虑流形覆盖和组合严谨性，而不是简单的数据集大小。PolyGen采用多石（Polylithic）方法，在架构上不同的生成器的交集中进行训练，有效地消除模型特有的伪影。此外，我们引入了一个程序性硬负例课程，以强制进行细粒度的句法理解。通过将相同的数据预算从独特的标题结构性地重新分配给多源变体，PolyGen实现了更鲁棒的特征空间，在聚合多任务基准上比领先的单源基线（SynthCLIP）提高了+19.0%，在SugarCrepe++组合性基准上提高了+9.1%。这些结果表明，结构多样性比简单地增加单源样本量更能有效地扩展数据。
tldr: 合成数据在视觉-语言预训练中很有前景，但单一生成器存在偏见。PolyGen框架通过结合多个不同架构的生成器来解决这个问题，并引入了一个程序性硬负例课程来提高句法理解能力。与单一来源的基线SynthCLIP相比，PolyGen在多任务基准和组合性基准上都取得了显著的改进，表明结构多样性比增加单一来源样本量更有效。
ai_comments: 这项工作通过引入PolyGen框架，在利用合成数据进行视觉-语言预训练方面取得了显著进展。其核心创新在于采用多生成器集成方法来解决单一生成器引入的偏见问题，并引入程序性硬负例课程来提高句法理解能力。研究结果表明，结构多样性比单纯增加数据量更能有效地提升模型性能，为未来合成数据生成的研究提供了新的方向。然而，该方法在计算成本和实际应用中的可扩展性仍有待进一步探讨。
motivation: 当前最先进的合成数据方法依赖于单一生成器，这会导致生成器特有的频谱偏差并限制特征多样性。因此，需要一种新的方法来提高合成数据的多样性和鲁棒性。
method: PolyGen框架采用多生成器集成方法，训练多个架构不同的生成器，以消除模型特有的伪影。此外，还引入了一个程序性硬负例课程，以强制进行细粒度的句法理解。
results: PolyGen在多任务基准上的总体性能比领先的单源基线SynthCLIP提高了19.0%，在SugarCrepe++组合性基准上提高了9.1%。
conclusion: 结构多样性比简单增加单源样本量更能有效地扩展数据。

title: Trade-offs in Financial AI: Explainability in a Trilemma with Accuracy and Compliance
authors: Patricia Marcella Evite, Ekaterina Svetlova, Doina Bucur
abstract: As Artificial Intelligence (AI) becomes increasingly embedded in financial decision-making, the opacity of complex models presents significant challenges for professionals and regulators. While the field of Explainable AI (XAI) attempts to bridge this gap, current research often reduces the implementation challenge to a binary trade-off between model accuracy and explainability. This paper argues that such a view is insufficient for the financial domain, where algorithmic choices must navigate a complex sociotechnical web of strict regulatory bounds, budget constraints, and latency requirements. Through semi-structured interviews with twenty finance professionals, ranging from C-suite executives and developers to regulators across multiple regions, this study empirically investigates how practitioners prioritize explainability relative to four competing factors: accuracy, compliance, cost, and speed. Our findings reveal that these priorities are structured not as a simple trade-off, but as a system of distinct prerequisites and constraints. Accuracy and compliance emerge as non-negotiable "hygiene factors": without them, an AI system is viewed as a liability regardless of its transparency. Operational levers (speed and cost) serve as secondary constraints that determine practical feasibility, while ease of understanding functions as a gateway to adoption, shaping whether AI tools are trusted, used, and defensible in practice.
comment: 21 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to EUM (Edizioni Università di Macerata) series "Economics and Law", Special Issue: "Emerging Trends in FinTech and AI: Theory and Applications in Business, Economics, and Law"
zh_title: 金融人工智能中的权衡：准确性、合规性与可解释性的三难困境
translation: 随着人工智能（AI）日益融入金融决策，复杂模型的不可解释性给从业者和监管者带来了严峻挑战。虽然可解释人工智能（XAI）领域试图弥合这一差距，但当前研究常常将实施挑战简化为模型准确性和可解释性之间的二元权衡。本文认为，这种观点对于金融领域来说是不够的，因为算法选择必须在严格的监管界限、预算限制和延迟要求构成的复杂社会技术网络中进行导航。通过对二十位金融从业者（从高管、开发人员到多地区监管者）进行半结构化访谈，本研究实证调查了从业者相对于四个竞争因素：准确性、合规性、成本和速度，如何权衡可解释性。我们的研究结果表明，这些优先级并非简单的权衡关系，而是一个由不同的先决条件和约束条件构成的系统。准确性和合规性成为不可协商的“卫生因素”：没有它们，无论其透明度如何，AI系统都被视为一种负债。操作杠杆（速度和成本）充当决定实际可行性的次要约束，而易于理解的功能则作为采用的门户，影响着AI工具在实践中是否被信任、使用和辩护。
tldr: 金融AI面临准确性、合规性和可解释性的三难困境，但研究发现它们并非简单的权衡，而是存在“卫生因素”（准确性、合规性）、“运营杠杆”（速度、成本）和“采用门户”（可理解性）的层级关系。
ai_comments: 该研究通过访谈金融从业者，揭示了金融AI领域中可解释性、准确性、合规性、成本和速度之间复杂的相互作用，超越了以往简单的二元权衡模型。研究提出的“卫生因素”、“运营杠杆”和“采用门户”概念为理解和实践金融AI提供了新的视角，具有重要的理论和实践意义。然而，访谈样本的代表性和地区覆盖范围可能影响研究结果的普适性。
motivation: 现有研究将金融AI的挑战简化为准确性与可解释性的二元权衡，但这种观点忽视了金融领域复杂的监管、预算和延迟要求。本文旨在更全面地研究金融从业者如何在准确性、合规性、成本和速度等因素中权衡可解释性。
method: 通过对来自不同地区、不同层级的二十位金融从业者（包括高管、开发者和监管者）进行半结构化访谈，实证研究从业者如何权衡可解释性与其他四个因素：准确性、合规性、成本和速度。
results: 研究发现，准确性和合规性是不可协商的“卫生因素”，是AI系统可用性的前提。速度和成本是决定实际可行性的次要约束。而可理解性（易于理解）则是影响AI工具被信任、使用和辩护的关键因素，是采用的“门户”。
conclusion: 金融AI的权衡并非简单的三难困境，而是包含“卫生因素”、“运营杠杆”和“采用门户”的层级系统。准确性和合规性是基础，速度和成本是可行性约束，而可解释性是促进采用的关键。

title: Exposing and Defending the Achilles' Heel of Video Mixture-of-Experts
authors: Songping Wang, Qinglong Liu, Yueming Lyu, Ning Li, Ziwen He, Caifeng Shan
abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has demonstrated strong performance in video understanding tasks, yet its adversarial robustness remains underexplored. Existing attack methods often treat MoE as a unified architecture, overlooking the independent and collaborative weaknesses of key components such as routers and expert modules. To fill this gap, we propose Temporal Lipschitz-Guided Attacks (TLGA) to thoroughly investigate component-level vulnerabilities in video MoE models. We first design attacks on the router, revealing its independent weaknesses. Building on this, we introduce Joint Temporal Lipschitz-Guided Attacks (J-TLGA), which collaboratively perturb both routers and experts. This joint attack significantly amplifies adversarial effects and exposes the Achilles' Heel (collaborative weaknesses) of the MoE architecture. Based on these insights, we further propose Joint Temporal Lipschitz Adversarial Training (J-TLAT). J-TLAT performs joint training to further defend against collaborative weaknesses, enhancing component-wise robustness. Our framework is plug-and-play and reduces inference cost by more than 60% compared with dense models. It consistently enhances adversarial robustness across diverse datasets and architectures, effectively mitigating both the independent and collaborative weaknesses of MoE.
zh_title: 揭示和防御视频混合专家模型的阿喀琉斯之踵
translation: 混合专家（MoE）在视频理解任务中表现出强大的性能，但其对抗鲁棒性仍有待探索。现有的攻击方法通常将MoE视为一个统一的架构，而忽略了路由器和专家模块等关键组件的独立和协同弱点。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了时间Lipschitz引导攻击（TLGA），以彻底研究视频MoE模型的组件级漏洞。我们首先设计了针对路由器的攻击，揭示了其独立的弱点。在此基础上，我们引入了联合时间Lipschitz引导攻击（J-TLGA），协同扰动路由器和专家。这种联合攻击显著放大了对抗效应，并暴露了MoE架构的阿喀琉斯之踵（协同弱点）。基于这些见解，我们进一步提出了联合时间Lipschitz对抗训练（J-TLAT）。J-TLAT进行联合训练，以进一步防御协同弱点，提高组件级鲁棒性。我们的框架即插即用，与密集模型相比，推理成本降低了60%以上。它在不同的数据集和架构上一致地提高了对抗鲁棒性，有效缓解了MoE的独立和协同弱点。
tldr: 该研究首次深入探讨了视频混合专家（MoE）模型的对抗鲁棒性，发现其路由器和专家模块在独立和协同工作时都存在弱点。研究提出了TLGA和J-TLGA攻击方法来暴露这些弱点，并开发了J-TLAT训练方法来防御这些协同弱点，显著提高了MoE模型的鲁棒性，同时降低了推理成本。
ai_comments: 这项研究在视频MoE模型的对抗鲁棒性领域做出了重要贡献，首次深入分析了组件级的独立和协同弱点。提出的TLGA、J-TLGA攻击方法和J-TLAT防御方法为理解和提升MoE模型的鲁棒性提供了新的思路和工具。其即插即用的特性和显著的性能提升（包括成本降低）使其具有很高的应用价值。未来的工作可以进一步探索不同类型的MoE架构和更复杂的攻击场景。
motivation: 现有研究忽视了视频MoE模型的对抗鲁棒性，特别是其关键组件（如路由器和专家模块）的独立和协同弱点。
method: 提出TLGA攻击方法来暴露路由器和专家模块的独立弱点。在此基础上，提出J-TLGA攻击方法，协同扰动路由器和专家模块，以暴露MoE架构的协同弱点。最后，提出J-TLAT训练方法，通过协同训练来防御这些协同弱点，提高组件级鲁棒性。
results: J-TLGA攻击显著放大了对抗效果，揭示了MoE架构的协同弱点。J-TLAT训练方法通过协同训练，有效防御了独立和协同的弱点，提高了MoE模型的对抗鲁棒性，并使推理成本降低了60%以上，同时在不同数据集和架构上表现出一致的鲁棒性提升。
conclusion: 研究首次揭示了视频MoE模型的组件级对抗脆弱性，即独立和协同弱点，并提出了相应的攻击和防御方法（TLGA, J-TLGA, J-TLAT），有效提升了模型的鲁棒性并降低了计算成本。

title: Context Dependence and Reliability in Autoregressive Language Models
authors: Poushali Sengupta, Shashi Raj Pandey, Sabita Maharjan, Frank Eliassen
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) generate outputs by utilizing extensive context, which often includes redundant information from prompts, retrieved passages, and interaction history. In critical applications, it is vital to identify which context elements actually influence the output, as standard explanation methods struggle with redundancy and overlapping context. Minor changes in input can lead to unpredictable shifts in attribution scores, undermining interpretability and raising concerns about risks like prompt injection. This work addresses the challenge of distinguishing essential context elements from correlated ones. We introduce RISE (Redundancy-Insensitive Scoring of Explanation), a method that quantifies the unique influence of each input relative to others, minimizing the impact of redundancies and providing clearer, stable attributions. Experiments demonstrate that RISE offers more robust explanations than traditional methods, emphasizing the importance of conditional information for trustworthy LLM explanations and monitoring.
zh_title: 自回归语言模型中的上下文依赖性与可靠性
translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）通过利用广泛的上下文来生成输出，这些上下文通常包含来自提示、检索到的段落和交互历史的冗余信息。在关键应用中，识别哪些上下文元素实际影响了输出至关重要，因为标准的解释方法难以处理冗余和重叠的上下文。输入中微小的变化可能导致归因分数出现不可预测的偏移，破坏了可解释性，并引发了对提示注入等风险的担忧。这项工作解决了区分基本上下文元素与相关上下文元素的挑战。我们引入了RISE（冗余不敏感解释评分），一种量化每个输入相对于其他输入的独特影响的方法，以最小化冗余的影响并提供更清晰、更稳定的归因。实验证明，RISE比传统方法提供了更稳健的解释，强调了条件信息对于可信赖的LLM解释和监控的重要性。
tldr: LLM的上下文信息太多且有冗余，导致解释不准。我们发明了RISE方法，能有效去除冗余，给出更稳定、更可靠的“谁（什么上下文）导致了输出”的评分，对安全和监控很重要。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个名为RISE的新方法，专门用于解决大型语言模型（LLM）中上下文信息冗余导致的归因不稳定的问题。其重要性在于为LLM的可解释性和可靠性（尤其是在面对提示注入等风险时）提供了更稳定的度量标准。局限性是仅基于抽象描述，其实际效果的全面性有待验证。
motivation: LLM的输出依赖于大量上下文，其中包含冗余信息，但标准解释方法难以区分哪些上下文元素真正影响了输出，导致归因分数不稳定，影响了可解释性和对提示注入等风险的担忧。
method: 引入了RISE（Redundancy-Insensitive Scoring of Explanation）方法，该方法量化了每个输入相对于其他输入所产生的独特影响，以最小化冗余的影响并提供更清晰、更稳定的归因。
results: 实验证明，RISE比传统方法提供更稳健的解释。
conclusion: RISE提供了一种更稳健的解释方法，强调了条件信息对于可信赖的LLM解释和监控的重要性。

title: PromptRL: Prompt Matters in RL for Flow-Based Image Generation
authors: Fu-Yun Wang, Han Zhang, Michael Gharbi, Hongsheng Li, Taesung Park
abstract:
Flow matching models (FMs) have revolutionized text-to-image (T2I) generation, with reinforcement learning (RL) serving as a critical post-training strategy for alignment with reward objectives. In this research, we show that current RL pipelines for FMs suffer from two underappreciated yet important limitations: sample inefficiency due to insufficient generation diversity, and pronounced prompt overfitting, where models memorize specific training formulations and exhibit dramatic performance collapse when evaluated on semantically equivalent but stylistically varied prompts. We present PromptRL (Prompt Matters in RL for Flow-Based Image Generation), a framework that incorporates language models (LMs) as trainable prompt refinement agents directly within the flow-based RL optimization loop. This design yields two complementary benefits: rapid development of sophisticated prompt rewriting capabilities and, critically, a synergistic training regime that reshapes the optimization dynamics. PromptRL achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks, obtaining scores of 0.97 on GenEval, 0.98 on OCR accuracy, and 24.05 on PickScore.
  Furthermore, we validate the effectiveness of our RL approach on large-scale image editing models, improving the EditReward of FLUX.1-Kontext from 1.19 to 1.43 with only 0.06 million rollouts, surpassing Gemini 2.5 Flash Image (also known as Nano Banana), which scores 1.37, and achieving comparable performance with ReasonNet (1.44), which relied on fine-grained data annotations along with a complex multi-stage training. Our extensive experiments empirically demonstrate that PromptRL consistently achieves higher performance ceilings while requiring over 2$\times$ fewer rollouts compared to naive flow-only RL. Our code is available at https://github.com/G-U-N/UniRL.

title: MDS matrices from skew polynomials with automorphisms and derivations
authors: Atif Ahmad Khan, Shakir Ali, Elif Segah Oztas, Abhishek Kesarwani
abstract:
Maximum Distance Separable (MDS) matrices play a central role in coding theory and symmetric-key cryptography due to their optimal diffusion properties. In this paper, we present a construction of MDS matrices using skew polynomial rings \( \mathbb{F}_q[X;θ,δ] \), where \( θ\) is an automorphism and \( δ\) is a \( θ\)-derivation on \( \mathbb{F}_q \). We introduce the notion of \( δ_θ \)-circulant matrices and study their structural properties. Necessary and sufficient conditions are derived under which these matrices are involutory and satisfy the MDS property. The resulting $δ_θ$-circulant matrix can be viewed as a generalization of classical constructions obtained in the absence of $θ$-derivations. One of the main contribution of this work is the construction of quasi recursive MDS matrices. In the setting of the skew polynomial ring $\mathbb{F}_q[X;θ]$, we construct quasi recursive MDS matrices associated with companion matrices.
  These matrices are shown to be involutory, yielding a strict improvement over the quasi-involutory constructions previously reported in the literature. Several illustrative results and examples are also provided.

title: On the Power of (Approximate) Reward Models for Inference-Time Scaling
authors: Youheng Zhu, Yiping Lu
abstract:
Inference-time scaling has recently emerged as a powerful paradigm for improving the reasoning capability of large language models. Among various approaches, Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) has become a particularly important framework, enabling iterative generation, evaluation, rejection, and resampling of intermediate reasoning trajectories. A central component in this process is the reward model, which evaluates partial solutions and guides the allocation of computation during inference.
  However, in practice, true reward models are never available. All deployed systems rely on approximate reward models, raising a fundamental question: Why and when do approximate reward models suffice for effective inference-time scaling? In this work, we provide a theoretical answer. We identify the Bellman error of the approximate reward model as the key quantity governing the effectiveness of SMC-based inference-time scaling. For a reasoning process of length $T$, we show that if the Bellman error of the approximate reward model is bounded by $O(1/T)$, then combining this reward model with SMC reduces the computational complexity of reasoning from exponential in $T$ to polynomial in $T$. This yields an exponential improvement in inference efficiency despite using only approximate rewards.
zh_title: 关于（近似）奖励模型在推理时扩展方面的能力
translation:
最近，推理时扩展已成为提高大型语言模型推理能力的一种强大范式。在各种方法中，序列蒙特卡洛（SMC）已成为一个特别重要的框架，它能够对中间推理轨迹进行迭代生成、评估、拒绝和重采样。这个过程的一个核心组成部分是奖励模型，它评估部分解决方案并在推理过程中指导计算分配。
然而，在实践中，真实的奖励模型是永远不可用的。所有部署的系统都依赖于近似奖励模型，这引发了一个基本问题：为什么以及何时近似奖励模型足以实现有效的推理时扩展？在这项工作中，我们提供了一个理论答案。我们将近似奖励模型的Bellman误差确定为控制SMC-基推理时扩展有效性的关键量。对于长度为T的推理过程，我们证明，如果近似奖励模型的Bellman误差以O(1/T)为界，那么将该奖励模型与SMC相结合可以将推理的计算复杂度从T的指数级降低到T的多项式级。尽管只使用近似奖励，这可以带来推理效率的指数级提升。
tldr: 即使使用近似奖励模型，基于SMC的推理时扩展也可以将推理复杂度从指数级降低到多项式级，只要Bellman误差足够小。
ai_comments: 这项工作为理解和设计在实际应用中使用近似奖励模型的推理时扩展系统提供了重要的理论基础。其主要贡献在于量化了近似奖励模型的质量（通过Bellman误差）与推理效率之间的关系，并提出了一个明确的界限（O(1/T)）来实现显著的计算收益。这为未来的研究和工程实践指明了方向，即如何有效地利用有限或不精确的奖励信息来优化大型语言模型的推理过程。
motivation: 在实际应用中，真实的奖励模型是不可用的，所有部署的系统都依赖于近似奖励模型。这引发了一个基本问题：为什么以及何时近似奖励模型足以实现有效的推理时扩展？
method: 我们提供了理论分析，并将SMC与近似奖励模型相结合，以实现推理时扩展。
results: 我们证明，如果近似奖励模型的Bellman误差以O(1/T)为界，那么将该奖励模型与SMC相结合可以将推理的计算复杂度从T的指数级降低到T的多项式级。
conclusion: 近似奖励模型的Bellman误差是控制基于SMC的推理时扩展有效性的关键量。当Bellman误差以O(1/T)为界时，可以实现推理效率的指数级提升。

title: TriphiBot: A Triphibious Robot Combining FOC-based Propulsion with Eccentric Design
authors: Xiangyu Li, Mingwei Lai, Mengke Zhang, Junxiao Lin, Tiancheng Lai, Junping Zhi, Chao Xu, Fei Gao, Yanjun Cao
abstract: Triphibious robots capable of multi-domain motion and cross-domain transitions are promising to handle complex tasks across diverse environments. However, existing designs primarily focus on dual-mode platforms, and some designs suffer from high mechanical complexity or low propulsion efficiency, which limits their application. In this paper, we propose a novel triphibious robot capable of aerial, terrestrial, and aquatic motion, by a minimalist design combining a quadcopter structure with two passive wheels, without extra actuators. To address inefficiency of ground-support motion (moving on land/seabed) for quadcopter based designs, we introduce an eccentric Center of Gravity (CoG) design that inherently aligns thrust with motion, enhancing efficiency without specialized mechanical transformation designs. Furthermore, to address the drastic differences in motion control caused by different fluids (air and water), we develop a unified propulsion system based on Field-Oriented Control (FOC). This method resolves torque matching issues and enables precise, rapid bidirectional thrust across different mediums. Grounded in the perspective of living condition and ground support, we analyse the robot's dynamics and propose a Hybrid Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (HNMPC)-PID control system to ensure stable multi-domain motion and seamless transitions. Experimental results validate the robot's multi-domain motion and cross-mode transition capability, along with the efficiency and adaptability of the proposed propulsion system.

title: "If You're Very Clever, No One Knows You've Used It": The Social Dynamics of Developing Generative AI Literacy in the Workplace
authors: Qing, Marios Constantinides, Advait Sarkar, Duncan Brumby, Anna Cox
abstract: Generative AI (GenAI) tools are rapidly transforming knowledge work, making AI literacy a critical priority for organizations. However, research on AI literacy lacks empirical insight into how knowledge workers' beliefs around GenAI literacy are shaped by the social dynamics of the workplace, and how workers learn to apply GenAI tools in these environments. To address this gap, we conducted in-depth interviews with 19 knowledge workers across multiple sectors to examine how they develop GenAI competencies in real-world professional contexts. We found that, while knowledge sharing from colleagues supported learning, the ability to remove cues indicating GenAI use was perceived as validation of domain expertise. These behaviours ultimately reduced opportunities for learning via knowledge sharing and undermined transparency. To advance workplace AI literacy, we argue for fostering open dialogue, increasing visibility of user-generated knowledge, and greater emphasis on the benefits of collaborative learning for navigating rapid technological developments.

title: Disclose with Care: Designing Privacy Controls in Interview Chatbots
authors: Ziwen Li, Ziang Xiao, Tianshi Li
abstract: Collecting data on sensitive topics remains challenging in HCI, as participants often withhold information due to privacy concerns and social desirability bias. While chatbots' perceived anonymity may reduce these barriers, research paradoxically suggests people tend to over-share personal or sensitive information with chatbots. In this work, we explore privacy controls in chatbot interviews to address this problem. The privacy control allows participants to revise their transcripts at the end of the interview, featuring two design variants: free editing and AI-aided editing. In a between-subjects study \red{($N=188$)}, we compared no-editing, free-editing, and AI-aided editing conditions in a chatbot-based interview on a sensitive topic. Our results confirm the prevalent issue of oversharing in chatbot-based interviews and show that AI-aided editing serves as an effective privacy-control mechanism, reducing PII disclosure while maintaining data quality and user engagement, thereby offering a promising approach to balancing ethical practice and data quality in such interviews.

title: The Enhanced Physics-Informed Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks: Applications of Newton's Laws in Financial Deep Reinforcement Learning (RL) Algorithms
authors: Trang Thoi, Hung Tran, Tram Thoi, Huaiyang Zhong
abstract: Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL), a subset of machine learning focused on sequential decision-making, has emerged as a powerful approach for tackling financial trading problems. In finance, DRL is commonly used either to generate discrete trade signals or to determine continuous portfolio allocations. In this work, we propose a novel reinforcement learning framework for portfolio optimization that incorporates Physics-Informed Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (PIKANs) into several DRL algorithms. The approach replaces conventional multilayer perceptrons with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) in both actor and critic components-utilizing learnable B-spline univariate functions to achieve parameter-efficient and more interpretable function approximation. During actor updates, we introduce a physics-informed regularization loss that promotes second-order temporal consistency between observed return dynamics and the action-induced portfolio adjustments. The proposed framework is evaluated across three equity markets-China, Vietnam, and the United States, covering both emerging and developed economies. Across all three markets, PIKAN-based agents consistently deliver higher cumulative and annualized returns, superior Sharpe and Calmar ratios, and more favorable drawdown characteristics compared to both standard DRL baselines and classical online portfolio-selection methods. This yields more stable training, higher Sharpe ratios, and superior performance compared to traditional DRL counterparts. The approach is particularly valuable in highly dynamic and noisy financial markets, where conventional DRL often suffers from instability and poor generalization.

title: How well can VLMs rate audio descriptions: A multi-dimensional quantitative assessment framework
authors: Lana Do, Gio Jung, Juvenal Francisco Barajas, Andrew Taylor Scott, Shasta Ihorn, Alexander Mario Blum, Vassilis Athitsos, Ilmi Yoon
abstract: Digital video is central to communication, education, and entertainment, but without audio description (AD), blind and low-vision audiences are excluded. While crowdsourced platforms and vision-language-models (VLMs) expand AD production, quality is rarely checked systematically. Existing evaluations rely on NLP metrics and short-clip guidelines, leaving questions about what constitutes quality for full-length content and how to assess it at scale. To address these questions, we first developed a multi-dimensional assessment framework for uninterrupted, full-length video, grounded in professional guidelines and refined by accessibility specialists. Second, we integrated this framework into a comprehensive methodological workflow, utilizing Item Response Theory, to assess the proficiency of VLM and human raters against expert-established ground truth. Findings suggest that while VLMs can approximate ground-truth ratings with high alignment, their reasoning was found to be less reliable and actionable than that of human respondents. These insights show the potential of hybrid evaluation systems that leverage VLMs alongside human oversight, offering a path towards scalable AD quality control.

title: Stronger Semantic Encoders Can Harm Relighting Performance: Probing Visual Priors via Augmented Latent Intrinsics
authors: Xiaoyan Xing, Xiao Zhang, Sezer Karaoglu, Theo Gevers, Anand Bhattad
abstract: Image-to-image relighting requires representations that disentangle scene properties from illumination. Recent methods rely on latent intrinsic representations but remain under-constrained and often fail on challenging materials such as metal and glass. A natural hypothesis is that stronger pretrained visual priors should resolve these failures. We find the opposite: features from top-performing semantic encoders often degrade relighting quality, revealing a fundamental trade-off between semantic abstraction and photometric fidelity. We study this trade-off and introduce Augmented Latent Intrinsics (ALI), which balances semantic context and dense photometric structure by fusing features from a pixel-aligned visual encoder into a latent-intrinsic framework, together with a self-supervised refinement strategy to mitigate the scarcity of paired real-world data. Trained only on unlabeled real-world image pairs and paired with a dense, pixel-aligned visual prior, ALI achieves strong improvements in relighting, with the largest gains on complex, specular materials. Project page: https:\\augmented-latent-intrinsics.github.io

title: Nonlinear model reduction for transport-dominated problems
authors: Jan S. Hesthaven, Benjamin Peherstorfer, Benjamin Unger
abstract: This article surveys nonlinear model reduction methods that remain effective in regimes where linear reduced-space approximations are intrinsically inefficient, such as transport-dominated problems with wave-like phenomena and moving coherent structures, which are commonly associated with the Kolmogorov barrier. The article organizes nonlinear model reduction techniques around three key elements -- nonlinear parametrizations, reduced dynamics, and online solvers -- and categorizes existing approaches into transformation-based methods, online adaptive techniques, and formulations that combine generic nonlinear parametrizations with instantaneous residual minimization.

title: Instance-Guided Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Robotic Semantic Segmentation
authors: Michele Antonazzi, Lorenzo Signorelli, Matteo Luperto, Nicola Basilico
abstract: Semantic segmentation networks, which are essential for robotic perception, often suffer from performance degradation when the visual distribution of the deployment environment differs from that of the source dataset on which they were trained. Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA) addresses this challenge by adapting the network to the robot's target environment without external supervision, leveraging the large amounts of data a robot might naturally collect during long-term operation. In such settings, UDA methods can exploit multi-view consistency across the environment's map to fine-tune the model in an unsupervised fashion and mitigate domain shift. However, these approaches remain sensitive to cross-view instance-level inconsistencies. In this work, we propose a method that starts from a volumetric 3D map to generate multi-view consistent pseudo-labels. We then refine these labels using the zero-shot instance segmentation capabilities of a foundation model, enforcing instance-level coherence. The refined annotations serve as supervision for self-supervised fine-tuning, enabling the robot to adapt its perception system at deployment time. Experiments on real-world data demonstrate that our approach consistently improves performance over state-of-the-art UDA baselines based on multi-view consistency, without requiring any ground-truth labels in the target domain.

title: Rethinking Selective Knowledge Distillation
authors: Almog Tavor, Itay Ebenspanger, Neil Cnaan, Mor Geva
abstract: Growing efforts to improve knowledge distillation (KD) in large language models (LLMs) replace dense teacher supervision with selective distillation, which uses a subset of token positions, vocabulary classes, or training samples for supervision. However, it remains unclear which importance signals, selection policies, and their interplay are most effective. In this work, we revisit where and how to distill in autoregressive LLMs. We disentangle selective KD along the position, class, and sample axes and systematically compare importance signals and selection policies. Then, guided by this analysis, we identify underexplored opportunities and introduce student-entropy-guided position selection (SE-KD). Across a suite of benchmarks, SE-KD often improves accuracy, downstream task adherence, and memory efficiency over dense distillation. Extending this approach across the class and sample axes (SE-KD 3X) yields complementary efficiency gains that make offline teacher caching feasible. In practice, this reduces wall time by 70% and peak memory by 18%, while cutting storage usage by 80% over prior methods without sacrificing performance.

title: Living Contracts: Beyond Document-Centric Interaction with Legal Agreements
authors: Ziheng Huang, Robin Kar, Hari Sundaram, Tal August
abstract: User interaction with legal contracts has been limited to document reading, which is often complicated by complex, ambiguous legal language. We explore possible futures where contract interfaces go beyond single document interfaces to (1) educate users with legal rights not stated in the contract, (2) transform legal language into alternative representations to aid information tasks before, during, and after signing, and (3) proactively supply contractual information at relevant moments. We refer to these future interfaces collectively as Living Contracts. Using residential leases as a case study, we created three design probes representing different possible Living Contracts. A three-part qualitative study (N=18) revealed participants' barriers to interacting with contracts, including interpreting complex language, uncertainty about legal rights, and the pressure to sign quickly. Participants' feedback on the probes highlighted how Living Contracts have the potential to address these challenges and open new design opportunities for human-contract interactions beyond document reading.

title: An Odd Estimator for Shapley Values
authors: Fabian Fumagalli, Landon Butler, Justin Singh Kang, Kannan Ramchandran, R. Teal Witter
abstract: The Shapley value is a ubiquitous framework for attribution in machine learning, encompassing feature importance, data valuation, and causal inference. However, its exact computation is generally intractable, necessitating efficient approximation methods. While the most effective and popular estimators leverage the paired sampling heuristic to reduce estimation error, the theoretical mechanism driving this improvement has remained opaque. In this work, we provide an elegant and fundamental justification for paired sampling: we prove that the Shapley value depends exclusively on the odd component of the set function, and that paired sampling orthogonalizes the regression objective to filter out the irrelevant even component. Leveraging this insight, we propose OddSHAP, a novel consistent estimator that performs polynomial regression solely on the odd subspace. By utilizing the Fourier basis to isolate this subspace and employing a proxy model to identify high-impact interactions, OddSHAP overcomes the combinatorial explosion of higher-order approximations. Through an extensive benchmark evaluation, we find that OddSHAP achieves state-of-the-art estimation accuracy.

title: From Pragmas to Partners: A Symbiotic Evolution of Agentic High-Level Synthesis
authors: Niansong Zhang, Sunwoo Kim, Shreesha Srinath, Zhiru Zhang
abstract: The rise of large language models has sparked interest in AI-driven hardware design, raising the question: does high-level synthesis (HLS) still matter in the agentic era? We argue that HLS remains essential. While we expect mature agentic hardware systems to leverage both HLS and RTL, this paper focuses on HLS and its role in enabling agentic optimization. HLS offers faster iteration cycles, portability, and design permutability that make it a natural layer for agentic optimization.This position paper makes three contributions. First, we explain why HLS serves as a practical abstraction layer and a golden reference for agentic hardware design. Second, we identify key limitations of current HLS tools, namely inadequate performance feedback, rigid interfaces, and limited debuggability that agents are uniquely positioned to address. Third, we propose a taxonomy for the symbiotic evolution of agentic HLS, clarifying how responsibility shifts from human designers to AI agents as systems advance from copilots to autonomous design partners.

title: Feedback by Design: Understanding and Overcoming User Feedback Barriers in Conversational Agents
authors: Nikhil Sharma, Zheng Zhang, Daniel Lee, Namita Krishnan, Guang-Jie Ren, Ziang Xiao, Yunyao Li
abstract: High-quality feedback is essential for effective human-AI interaction. It bridges knowledge gaps, corrects digressions, and shapes system behavior; both during interaction and throughout model development. Yet despite its importance, human feedback to AI is often infrequent and low quality. This gap motivates a critical examination of human feedback during interactions with AIs. To understand and overcome the challenges preventing users from giving high-quality feedback, we conducted two studies examining feedback dynamics between humans and conversational agents (CAs). Our formative study, through the lens of Grice's maxims, identified four Feedback Barriers -- Common Ground, Verifiability, Communication, and Informativeness -- that prevent high-quality feedback by users. Building on these findings, we derive three design desiderata and show that systems incorporating scaffolds aligned with these desiderata enabled users to provide higher-quality feedback. Finally, we detail a call for action to the broader AI community for advances in Large Language Models capabilities to overcome Feedback Barriers.
comment: Proceedings of the 2026 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems, 23 pages, 3 figures

title: BOA Constrictor: Squeezing Performance out of GPUs in the Cloud via Budget-Optimal Allocation
authors: Zhouzi Li, Cindy Zhu, Arpan Mukhopadhyay, Mor Harchol-Balter, Benjamin Berg
abstract:
The past decade has seen a dramatic increase in demand for GPUs to train Machine Learning (ML) models. Because it is prohibitively expensive for most organizations to build and maintain a large GPU cluster, organizations instead choose to rent GPUs from cloud providers. The customer is responsible for devising a policy for (i) deciding how many GPUs to rent at every moment in time to process a stream of ML training jobs and (ii) allocating the rented GPUs among the currently active jobs in the system. Because ML training jobs can be parallelized across different numbers of GPUs, the customer generally has many options for how many GPUs to use for each job. Allocating more GPUs to a single training job will cause the job to complete more quickly. However, the customer pays for each GPU-hour they use, and a training job receives a diminishing marginal benefit from running on additional GPUs. Hence, allocating too many GPUs to a single training job can dramatically increase the overall cost that the customer pays to the cloud provider. This gives rise to a cost-performance tradeoff that customers must balance when running training jobs in the cloud.
  To balance the cost-performance tradeoff, we develop BOA Constrictor, a new scheduler for ML training jobs which uses a Budget-Optimal Allocation (BOA) policy to squeeze the highest level of performance out of a cloud-deployed GPU cluster given a fixed budget constraint. We explicitly formulate the problem as a budget-constrained scheduling problem and derive the BOA policy which minimizes the average job completion time (JCT) of a stream of arriving jobs subject to the user's budget. For a given budget level, we demonstrate that BOA Constrictor can reduce average JCT by 1.6 times in small-scale implementation experiments and by 2 times in detailed, large-scale simulations compared to state-of-the-art heuristic based schedulers.

title: SNIP: An Adaptive Mixed Precision Framework for Subbyte Large Language Model Training
authors: Yunjie Pan, Yongyi Yang, Hanmei Yang, Scott Mahlke
abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) efficiently while preserving model quality poses significant challenges, particularly with subbyte precision supported by state-of-the-art GPUs.
