title: Calibrating Adaptive Smoothing Methods for Freeway Traffic Reconstruction
authors: Junyi Ji, Derek Gloudemans, Gergely Zachár, Matthew Nice, William Barbour, Daniel B. Work
abstract: The adaptive smoothing method (ASM) is a widely used approach for traffic state reconstruction. This article presents a Python implementation of ASM, featuring end-to-end calibration using real-world ground truth data. The calibration is formulated as a parameterized kernel optimization problem. The model is calibrated using data from a full-state observation testbed, with input from a sparse radar sensor network. The implementation is developed in PyTorch, enabling integration with various deep learning methods. We evaluate the results in terms of speed distribution, spatio-temporal error distribution, and spatial error to provide benchmark metrics for the traffic reconstruction problem. We further demonstrate the usability of the calibrated method across multiple freeways. Finally, we discuss the challenges of reproducibility in general traffic model calibration and the limitations of ASM. This article is reproducible and can serve as a benchmark for various freeway operation tasks.
zh_title: 高速公路交通重构中自适应平滑方法的校准
translation: 自适应平滑方法（ASM）是交通状态重构中广泛使用的方法。本文提出了ASM的Python实现，其特点是使用真实世界地面真值数据进行端到端校准。该校准被表述为一个参数化的核优化问题。该模型使用来自全状态观测试验台的数据进行校准，输入来自稀疏雷达传感器网络。该实现是在PyTorch中开发的，能够与各种深度学习方法集成。我们从速度分布、时空误差分布和空间误差方面评估结果，为交通重构问题提供基准指标。我们进一步证明了校准后的方法在多条高速公路上的可用性。最后，我们讨论了一般交通模型校准中可复现性的挑战以及ASM的局限性。本文是可复现的，可作为各种高速公路运行任务的基准。
tldr: 本文提供了一个基于PyTorch实现的自适应平滑方法（ASM）的端到端校准方案，通过参数化核优化使用真实数据进行校准，并提供了性能基准，证明了其在高速公路交通重构中的可用性。
ai_comments: 该论文的主要创新点在于提出了一个基于参数化核优化的自适应平滑方法（ASM）的端到端校准框架，并提供了可复现的PyTorch实现，这对于交通重构问题的基准测试具有重要意义。局限性在于讨论了ASM在模型校准中可复现性的挑战。
motivation: 自适应平滑方法（ASM）是交通状态重构中广泛使用的方法，需要对其进行准确的校准以提高性能。
method: 提出了一个将ASM校准表述为参数化核优化问题的框架，并使用真实世界地面真值数据进行端到端校准。实现基于PyTorch开发，使用稀疏雷达传感器网络的输入，在全状态观测试验台上进行模型校准。
results: 成功实现了ASM的Python/PyTorch版本，并使用真实世界数据进行了端到端校准。评估指标包括速度分布、时空误差分布和空间误差，为交通重构问题提供了基准指标。校准后的方法在多个高速公路上表现出可用性。
conclusion: 该研究展示了校准后的方法在多个高速公路上的可用性，并讨论了通用交通模型校准中可复现性的挑战以及ASM的局限性。该文章是可复现的，可作为各种高速公路运行任务的基准。

title: On the Numerical Treatment of an Abstract Nonlinear System of Coupled Hyperbolic Equations Associated with the Timoshenko Model
authors: Jemal Rogava, Zurab Vashakidze
abstract: The present work addresses the Cauchy problem for an abstract nonlinear system of coupled hyperbolic equations associated with the Timoshenko model in a real Hilbert space. Our purpose is to develop and delve into a temporal discretization scheme for approximating a solution to this problem. To this end, we propose a symmetric three-layer semi-discrete time-stepping scheme in which the nonlinear term is evaluated at the temporal midpoint. As a result, at each time step, this approach reduces the original nonlinear problem to a linear one and enables parallel computation of its solution. Convergence is proved, and second-order accuracy with respect to the time-step size is established on a local temporal interval. The proposed scheme is then applied to a spatially one-dimensional nonlinear dynamic Timoshenko beam system, and the results obtained for the abstract nonlinear system are extended to this setting. A Legendre-Galerkin spectral approximation is employed for the spatial discretization. By taking differences of Legendre polynomials within the Galerkin framework, the resulting linear system is sparse and can be efficiently decoupled. The convergence of the method is also investigated. Finally, several numerical experiments on carefully chosen benchmark problems are conducted to validate the proposed approach and to confirm the theoretical findings.
zh_title: 关于与Timoshenko模型相关的抽象非线性耦合双曲方程组的数值处理
translation: 本工作解决了在实希尔伯特空间中与Timoshenko模型相关的抽象非线性耦合双曲方程组的柯西问题。我们的目的是为逼近该问题的解而开发并深入研究一种时间离散化格式。为此，我们提出了一种对称三层半离散时间步进格式，其中非线性项在时间中点进行评估。结果是，在每一步，该方法将原始非线性问题简化为线性问题，并使其解的并行计算成为可能。证明了收敛性，并确定了在局部时间区间上相对于时间步长具有二阶精度。然后，所提出的格式被应用于一个空间一维的非线性动态Timoshenko梁系统，并将所得的抽象非线性系统的结果推广到该设置中。空间离散化采用了勒让德-伽辽金谱近似。通过在伽辽金框架内对勒让德多项式取差分，得到的线性系统是稀疏的，可以有效地解耦。还研究了该方法的收敛性。最后，对精心选择的基准问题进行了一些数值实验，以验证所提出的方法并确认理论发现。
tldr: 研究人员为Timoshenko模型相关的非线性双曲方程组设计了一种新的时间离散化方法，它能将每一步的非线性问题简化为线性问题，从而支持并行计算，并且在理论上证明了二阶精度和收敛性，并通过算例验证了其有效性。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一种对称三层半离散时间步进格式，并将非线性项置于时间中点进行评估，从而将非线性问题简化为线性问题，并支持并行计算。其重要性在于为Timoshenko模型相关的非线性耦合双曲方程组的求解提供了一种高效且理论上可靠的数值方法。局限性方面，摘要未明确指出。
motivation: 研究的目的是为抽象非线性耦合双曲方程组（与Timoshenko模型相关）的Cauchy问题开发并深入研究一种时间离散化方案来近似求解。
method: 提出了一种对称三层半离散时间步进格式，其中非线性项在时间中点评估，将原非线性问题简化为线性问题，支持并行计算。空间离散化采用了勒让德-伽辽金谱近似，利用勒让德多项式的差分使所得线性系统稀疏且易于解耦。
results: 所提出的格式在局部时间区间上被证明是收敛的，并且相对于时间步长具有二阶精度。将该方法应用于一维非线性动态Timoshenko梁系统，并对所得线性系统进行了收敛性研究。数值实验验证了该方法的有效性。
conclusion: 该研究成功地为抽象非线性耦合双曲方程组（与Timoshenko模型相关）提出并分析了一种数值方法，并通过数值实验验证了其有效性和理论结果。

title: Multi-View Stenosis Classification Leveraging Transformer-Based Multiple-Instance Learning Using Real-World Clinical Data
authors: Nikola Cenikj, Özgün Turgut, Alexander Müller, Alexander Steger, Jan Kehrer, Marcus Brugger, Daniel Rueckert, Eimo Martens, Philip Müller
abstract: Coronary artery stenosis is a leading cause of cardiovascular disease, diagnosed by analyzing the coronary arteries from multiple angiography views. Although numerous deep-learning models have been proposed for stenosis detection from a single angiography view, their performance heavily relies on expensive view-level annotations, which are often not readily available in hospital systems. Moreover, these models fail to capture the temporal dynamics and dependencies among multiple views, which are crucial for clinical diagnosis. To address this, we propose SegmentMIL, a transformer-based multi-view multiple-instance learning framework for patient-level stenosis classification. Trained on a real-world clinical dataset, using patient-level supervision and without any view-level annotations, SegmentMIL jointly predicts the presence of stenosis and localizes the affected anatomical region, distinguishing between the right and left coronary arteries and their respective segments. SegmentMIL obtains high performance on internal and external evaluations and outperforms both view-level models and classical MIL baselines, underscoring its potential as a clinically viable and scalable solution for coronary stenosis diagnosis. Our code is available at https://github.com/NikolaCenic/mil-stenosis.
zh_title: 多视图狭窄分类利用基于Transformer的多实例学习和真实世界临床数据
translation: 冠状动脉狭窄是心血管疾病的主要原因，通过分析多个血管造影视图中的冠状动脉进行诊断。尽管已经提出了许多用于单视图血管造影图像狭窄检测的深度学习模型，但其性能严重依赖于昂贵的视图级标注，而这些标注在医院系统中通常不易获得。此外，这些模型未能捕捉多视图之间的时序动态和依赖关系，这对于临床诊断至关重要。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了SegmentMIL，一个基于Transformer的多视图多实例学习框架，用于患者级别的狭窄分类。SegmentMIL在真实世界的临床数据集上进行训练，使用患者级别的监督，并且无需任何视图级标注，它能同时预测狭窄的存在并定位受影响的解剖区域，区分左右冠状动脉及其各自的节段。SegmentMIL在内部和外部评估中均获得了高性能，并且优于视图级模型和经典的MIL基线，这突显了其作为冠状动脉狭窄诊断的临床可行和可扩展解决方案的潜力。我们的代码可在https://github.com/NikolaCenic/mil-stenosis获取。
tldr: SegmentMIL是一个基于Transformer的多实例学习框架，用于在没有视图级标注的情况下，通过多视图血管造影图像对患者级别冠状动脉狭窄进行分类和定位，并在真实临床数据上表现优异。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个无需视图级标注的多视图多实例学习框架（SegmentMIL），解决了真实世界临床数据中标注稀缺的问题。通过利用Transformer架构处理多视图间的依赖关系，并实现患者级别的狭窄分类和区域定位，SegmentMIL为冠状动脉狭窄诊断提供了一个更实用和可扩展的解决方案，具有重要的临床应用价值。
motivation: 现有的深度学习模型在单视图血管造影图像上检测狭窄，但它们依赖昂贵的视图级标注且无法捕捉多视图间的时序动态和依赖关系，而这些对于临床诊断至关重要。
method: 提出了SegmentMIL，一个基于Transformer的多视图多实例学习框架，用于患者级别的狭窄分类。它在真实世界的临床数据集上进行训练，使用患者级别的监督，无需视图级标注。SegmentMIL能同时预测狭窄的存在并定位受影响的解剖区域（区分左右冠状动脉及其节段）。
results: SegmentMIL在内部和外部评估中均表现出色，并且优于视图级模型和经典的MIL基线。
conclusion: SegmentMIL具有作为冠状动脉狭窄诊断的临床可行和可扩展解决方案的潜力。

title: AICD Bench: A Challenging Benchmark for AI-Generated Code Detection
authors: Daniil Orel, Dilshod Azizov, Indraneil Paul, Yuxia Wang, Iryna Gurevych, Preslav Nakov
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly capable of generating functional source code, raising concerns about authorship, accountability, and security. While detecting AI-generated code is critical, existing datasets and benchmarks are narrow, typically limited to binary human-machine classification under in-distribution settings. To bridge this gap, we introduce $\emph{AICD Bench}$, the most comprehensive benchmark for AI-generated code detection. It spans $\emph{2M examples}$, $\emph{77 models}$ across $\emph{11 families}$, and $\emph{9 programming languages}$, including recent reasoning models. Beyond scale, AICD Bench introduces three realistic detection tasks: ($\emph{i}$)~$\emph{Robust Binary Classification}$ under distribution shifts in language and domain, ($\emph{ii}$)~$\emph{Model Family Attribution}$, grouping generators by architectural lineage, and ($\emph{iii}$)~$\emph{Fine-Grained Human-Machine Classification}$ across human, machine, hybrid, and adversarial code. Extensive evaluation on neural and classical detectors shows that performance remains far below practical usability, particularly under distribution shift and for hybrid or adversarial code. We release AICD Bench as a $\emph{unified, challenging evaluation suite}$ to drive the next generation of robust approaches for AI-generated code detection. The data and the code are available at https://huggingface.co/AICD-bench}.
zh_title: AICD Bench：一个具有挑战性的AI生成代码检测基准
translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）生成功能性源代码的能力日益增强，引发了对作者身份、问责制和安全性的担忧。尽管检测AI生成代码至关重要，但现有的数据集和基准范围狭窄，通常仅限于同分布设置下的二元人机分类。为弥补这一差距，我们推出了$\emph{AICD Bench}$，迄今为止最全面的AI生成代码检测基准。它涵盖了$\emph{200万个样本}$、$\emph{77个模型}$（跨$\emph{11个家族}$）以及$\emph{9种编程语言}$，包括最新的推理模型。除了规模，AICD Bench还引入了三个现实的检测任务：（$\emph{i}$）语言和领域分布偏移下的$\emph{鲁棒二元分类}$，（$\emph{ii}$）按架构谱系对生成器进行分组的$\emph{模型家族归因}$，以及（$\emph{iii}$）跨越人类、机器、混合和对抗性代码的$\emph{细粒度人机分类}$。对神经和经典检测器的广泛评估表明，性能远未达到实际可用水平，尤其是在分布偏移下以及对于混合或对抗性代码。我们将AICD Bench发布为一个$\emph{统一的、具有挑战性的评估套件}$，以推动下一代鲁棒的AI生成代码检测方法。数据和代码可在https://huggingface.co/AICD-bench获取。
tldr: 研究人员发布了AICD Bench，一个包含200万样本、涵盖77个模型的综合性AI生成代码检测基准，旨在解决现有基准的局限性。该基准测试了鲁棒性、模型归因和细粒度分类，发现现有检测器在真实场景下表现不佳。
ai_comments: 该基准的创新之处在于其规模和引入的三个更贴近实际场景的检测任务（鲁棒二元分类、模型家族归因、细粒度人机分类），强调了现有检测方法的局限性，尤其是在分布偏移和处理混合/对抗性代码方面。其重要性在于为AI生成代码检测领域提供了一个统一且更具挑战性的评估标准。局限性在于，摘要中未提及该基准的构建细节或可能存在的偏见。
motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）生成代码的能力日益增强，引发了对作者身份、问责制和安全性的担忧。现有的数据集和基准过于狭窄，通常仅限于同分布设置下的二元人机分类，无法满足实际需求。
method: 引入AICD Bench，一个包含200万个样本、涵盖77个模型（来自11个家族）和9种编程语言的综合基准。该基准支持三种现实的检测任务：（i）鲁棒二元分类（处理分布偏移），（ii）模型家族归因，（iii）细粒度人机分类（区分人类、机器、混合和对抗性代码）。
results: 对神经和经典检测器进行的广泛评估显示，性能远低于实际可用水平，特别是在存在分布偏移以及面对混合或对抗性代码时。
conclusion: 对现有神经和经典检测器的广泛评估表明，性能远未达到实际可用水平，特别是在分布偏移以及处理混合或对抗性代码时。AICD Bench作为一个统一的、具有挑战性的评估套件发布，旨在推动下一代鲁棒的AI生成代码检测方法的发展。

title: Active learning from positive and unlabeled examples
authors: Farnam Mansouri, Sandra Zilles, Shai Ben-David
abstract: Learning from positive and unlabeled data (PU learning) is a weakly supervised variant of binary classification in which the learner receives labels only for (some) positively labeled instances, while all other examples remain unlabeled. Motivated by applications such as advertising and anomaly detection, we study an active PU learning setting where the learner can adaptively query instances from an unlabeled pool, but a queried label is revealed only when the instance is positive and an independent coin flip succeeds; otherwise the learner receives no information. In this paper, we provide the first theoretical analysis of the label complexity of active PU learning.
zh_title: 从正面和未标记示例中进行主动学习
translation: 从正面和未标记数据中学习（PU学习）是二元分类的一种弱监督变体，其中学习器只接收（部分）正面标记实例的标签，而所有其他实例保持未标记。受广告和异常检测等应用的激励，我们研究了一种主动式PU学习设置，其中学习器可以自适应地从一个未标记池中查询实例，但查询到的标签只有在实例为正且一个独立的硬币翻转成功时才会显示；否则学习者将接收不到任何信息。在本文中，我们首次提供了主动式PU学习的标签复杂度的理论分析。
tldr: 在PU学习场景下，如果查询标签时只有正面样本有一定概率给出标签，作者首次从理论上分析了在这种限制性主动学习设置下的标签复杂度。
ai_comments: 该研究首次对主动式PU学习的标签复杂度进行了理论分析，提出了在仅能从正面样本中获得部分标签反馈的限制性条件下进行有效学习的机制，具有重要的理论意义。
motivation: 广告和异常检测等应用场景中对仅有正面和未标记数据进行学习的需求。
method: 理论分析（针对标签复杂度）
results: 提供了主动式PU学习的标签复杂度的首次理论分析。

title: Learning Half-Spaces from Perturbed Contrastive Examples
authors: Aryan Alavi Razavi Ravari, Farnam Mansouri, Yuxin Chen, Valentio Iverson, Adish Singla, Sandra Zilles
abstract:
We study learning under a two-step contrastive example oracle, as introduced by Mansouri et. al. (2025), where each queried (or sampled) labeled example is paired with an additional contrastive example of opposite label. While Mansouri et al. assume an idealized setting, where the contrastive example is at minimum distance of the originally queried/sampled point, we introduce and analyze a mechanism, parameterized by a non-decreasing noise function $f$, under which this ideal contrastive example is perturbed. The amount of perturbation is controlled by $f(d)$, where $d$ is the distance of the queried/sampled point to the decision boundary. Intuitively, this results in higher-quality contrastive examples for points closer to the decision boundary. We study this model in two settings: (i) when the maximum perturbation magnitude is fixed, and (ii) when it is stochastic.
  For one-dimensional thresholds and for half-spaces under the uniform distribution on a bounded domain, we characterize active and passive contrastive sample complexity in dependence on the function $f$. We show that, under certain conditions on $f$, the presence of contrastive examples speeds up learning in terms of asymptotic query complexity and asymptotic expected query complexity.
zh_title: 从受扰动的对比样本中学习半空间
translation: 我们研究了 Mansouri 等人（2025）引入的两步对比样本预言机下的学习问题，在该预言机中，每个被查询的（或采样的）带标签样本都与一个具有相反标签的额外对比样本配对。虽然 Mansouri 等人假设了一个理想化的设置，即对比样本与原始查询/采样点的最小距离，但我们引入并分析了一种机制，由一个非递增的噪声函数 $f$ 参数化，在该机制下，这个理想的对比样本会受到扰动。扰动的量由 $f(d)$ 控制，其中 $d$ 是查询/采样点到决策边界的距离。直观地说，这对更靠近决策边界的点产生了更高质量的对比样本。我们研究了该模型在两种设置下：（i）最大扰动幅度是固定的，和（ii）最大扰动是随机的。对于一维阈值和在有界域上均匀分布下的半空间，我们根据函数 $f$ 的特性，刻画了主动和被动对比样本的样本复杂度。我们证明，在对 $f$ 满足特定条件下，对比样本的存在可以加速学习，体现在渐近查询复杂度和渐近期望查询复杂度上。
tldr: 研究了在对比学习中，当对比样本因查询点离决策边界的远近而受到不同程度扰动时，学习半空间所需样本量和速度的变化，发现合适的扰动机制（即函数 $f$）可以加速学习。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于引入了一个受扰动的对比样本模型，超越了先前研究中的理想化设置，并分析了这种扰动对半空间学习复杂度的影响。其重要性在于为更现实的学习场景（其中对比样本可能不完美）提供了理论分析。限制在于分析主要集中在一维阈值和均匀分布下的半空间。
motivation: 研究在 Mansouri 等人引入的两步对比样本预言机模型下进行学习，但该模型假设对比样本是理想的（与原始样本距离最小），而本文旨在引入并分析一个更现实的机制，其中对比样本会受到扰动，扰动程度取决于查询点与决策边界的距离。
method: 研究了在受扰动的两步对比样本预言机下的学习问题，该扰动机制由一个非递增的噪声函数 $f$ 参数化，扰动量由 $f(d)$ 控制，其中 $d$ 是查询点到决策边界的距离。在固定最大扰动幅度和随机扰动这两种设置下，对一维阈值和均匀分布下的半空间进行了分析。
results: 对于一维阈值和均匀分布下的半空间，根据函数 $f$ 的不同，刻画了主动和被动对比样本的样本复杂度。证明了在满足 $f$ 的特定条件下，对比样本的存在可以加速学习（在渐近查询复杂度和渐近期望查询复杂度方面）。
conclusion: 在对函数 $f$ 满足特定条件的情况下，对比样本的存在可以加速学习，体现在渐近查询复杂度和渐近期望查询复杂度上的提升。

title: Closing the Loop: Universal Repository Representation with RPG-Encoder
authors: Jane Luo, Chengyu Yin, Xin Zhang, Qingtao Li, Steven Liu, Yiming Huang, Jie Wu, Hao Liu, Yangyu Huang, Yu Kang, Fangkai Yang, Ying Xin, Scarlett Li
abstract: Current repository agents encounter a reasoning disconnect due to fragmented representations, as existing methods rely on isolated API documentation or dependency graphs that lack semantic depth. We consider repository comprehension and generation to be inverse processes within a unified cycle: generation expands intent into implementation, while comprehension compresses implementation back into intent. To address this, we propose RPG-Encoder, a framework that generalizes the Repository Planning Graph (RPG) from a static generative blueprint into a unified, high-fidelity representation. RPG-Encoder closes the reasoning loop through three mechanisms: (1) Encoding raw code into the RPG that combines lifted semantic features with code dependencies; (2) Evolving the topology incrementally to decouple maintenance costs from repository scale, reducing overhead by 95.7%; and (3) Operating as a unified interface for structure-aware navigation. In evaluations, RPG-Encoder establishes state-of-the-art repository understanding on SWE-bench Verified with 93.7% Acc@5 and exceeds the best baseline by over 10% on SWE-bench Live Lite. These results highlight our superior fine-grained localization accuracy in complex codebases. Furthermore, it achieves 98.5% reconstruction coverage on RepoCraft, confirming RPG's high-fidelity capacity to mirror the original codebase and closing the loop between intent and implementation.
zh_title: 闭合循环：具有RPG-Encoder的通用代码仓库表示
translation: 当前的代码仓库智能体由于依赖于缺乏语义深度的隔离API文档或依赖图，遇到了推理断裂。我们将代码仓库的理解和生成视为一个统一周期内的逆过程：生成将意图扩展为实现，而理解则将实现压缩回意图。为解决此问题，我们提出了RPG-Encoder，一个将Repository Planning Graph（RPG）从静态生成蓝图泛化为统一、高保真表示的框架。RPG-Encoder通过三种机制闭合了推理循环：(1) 将原始代码编码到RPG中，该编码结合了提升的语义特征和代码依赖；(2) 增量演化拓扑结构，以将维护成本与仓库规模解耦，将开销降低了95.7%；(3) 作为一个结构感知的统一导航接口。在评估中，RPG-Encoder在SWE-bench Verified上建立了最先进的仓库理解水平，Acc@5达到93.7%，并在SWE-bench Live Lite上超过了最佳基线10%以上。这些结果突显了我们在复杂代码库中优越的精细定位准确性。此外，它在RepoCraft上实现了98.5%的重构覆盖率，证实了RPG高保真地反映原始代码的能力，从而闭合了意图与实现之间的循环。
tldr: 为了解决代码仓库智能体推理断裂的问题，我们提出了RPG-Encoder，它将代码的语义和结构信息整合到一个可扩展的、高保真的Repository Planning Graph (RPG) 中，成功地连接了代码意图和实现，并在基准测试中取得了SOTA性能，同时大幅降低了维护成本。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于将代码仓库的理解和生成视为一个统一的循环过程，并提出了RPG-Encoder来构建高保真、统一的表示。通过增量演化拓扑结构来解决可扩展性问题是一个重要的工程贡献。然而，论文的局限性在于其对“语义深度”的定义和衡量可能需要更详细的说明。RPG-Encoder的性能提升显著，尤其是在SWE-bench上的表现。
motivation: 现有的代码仓库智能体由于依赖隔离的API文档或依赖图，缺乏语义深度，导致推理出现断裂。作者认为代码仓库的理解和生成是统一周期内的逆过程，需要一个统一的、高保真的表示来连接意图和实现。
method: 提出RPG-Encoder框架，将静态的RPG（Repository Planning Graph）泛化为统一的高保真表示。该框架通过 (1) 将原始代码编码到RPG中，结合提升的语义特征和代码依赖；(2) 增量演化拓扑结构以解耦维护成本与仓库规模；(3) 作为结构感知导航的统一接口来闭合推理循环。
results: RPG-Encoder在SWE-bench Verified上取得了93.7%的Acc@5的最新性能，比最佳基线提高了10%以上；维护开销减少了95.7%；在RepoCraft上实现了98.5%的重构覆盖率。
conclusion: RPG-Encoder成功地通过结合语义特征和代码依赖关系，构建了一个统一的高保真代码仓库表示（RPG），实现了推理闭环，并在代码理解和重构任务上取得了最先进的性能，证明了其在复杂代码库中进行精细定位的能力。

title: Efficient Swap Regret Minimization in Combinatorial Bandits
authors: Andreas Kontogiannis, Vasilis Pollatos, Panayotis Mertikopoulos, Ioannis Panageas
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of designing efficient no-swap regret algorithms for combinatorial bandits, where the number of actions $N$ is exponentially large in the dimensionality of the problem. In this setting, designing efficient no-swap regret translates to sublinear -- in horizon $T$ -- swap regret with polylogarithmic dependence on $N$. In contrast to the weaker notion of external regret minimization - a problem which is fairly well understood in the literature - achieving no-swap regret with a polylogarithmic dependence on $N$ has remained elusive in combinatorial bandits. Our paper resolves this challenge, by introducing a no-swap-regret learning algorithm with regret that scales polylogarithmically in $N$ and is tight for the class of combinatorial bandits. To ground our results, we also demonstrate how to implement the proposed algorithm efficiently -- that is, with a per-iteration complexity that also scales polylogarithmically in $N$ -- across a wide range of well-studied applications.
zh_title: 组合博弈中的高效交换遗憾最小化
translation: 本文解决了设计组合博弈中高效无交换遗憾算法的问题，其中动作数量 $N$ 相对于问题的维度呈指数级增长。在这种情况下，设计高效的无交换遗憾意味着在时间 $T$ 上呈亚线性遗憾，而对 $N$ 的依赖呈对数级别。与文献中对外部遗憾最小化的较弱概念相比，实现对 $N$ 呈对数依赖性的无交换遗憾在组合博弈中一直难以实现。我们的论文解决了这一挑战，引入了一种无交换遗憾学习算法，其遗憾关于 $N$ 呈对数级别缩放，并且对于该类组合博弈来说是紧凑的。为了印证我们的结果，我们还展示了如何高效地实现所提出的算法——即每迭代复杂度也呈对数级别缩放于 $N$ ——跨越广泛研究的应用。
tldr: 研究人员解决了组合博弈中难以实现的“无交换遗憾”最小化问题，提出了一个算法，其遗憾和计算效率都与指数级增长的动作空间大小 $N$ 呈对数关系，取得了理论上的突破。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于解决了组合博弈中高效“无交换遗憾”最小化这一长期存在的难题，并实现了关于动作集大小 $N$ 的对数级别的依赖性，这在文献中是难以实现的。其重要性在于为具有指数级动作空间的决策问题提供了更严格的遗憾界限。方法论上，它提出了一个新的学习算法和一种高效的迭代实现方式。
motivation: 在组合博弈中，动作数量 $N$ 相对于问题维度呈指数级增长，设计高效的无交换遗憾算法（即遗憾关于时间 $T$ 呈亚线性，关于 $N$ 呈对数级别）一直是一个难以解决的挑战，与外部遗憾最小化（该问题已有较好理解）形成对比。
method: 提出了一种新的无交换遗憾学习算法，并展示了如何在广泛应用中以关于 $N$ 呈对数级别的复杂度高效实现该算法（即每迭代复杂度也呈对数级别）。
results: 论文提出了一个无交换遗憾学习算法，其遗憾关于 $N$ 呈对数级别缩放，并且对于组合博弈的类别来说是紧凑的。同时，该算法的每迭代复杂度也呈对数级别缩放。
conclusion: 论文解决了在组合博弈中实现遗憾关于 $N$ 呈对数依赖性的无交换遗憾学习的挑战，并证明了所提出的算法的遗憾界限对于该类组合博弈是紧凑的。

title: LEC-KG: An LLM-Embedding Collaborative Framework for Domain-Specific Knowledge Graph Construction -- A Case Study on SDGs
authors: Yikai Zeng, Yingchao Piao, Jianhui Li
abstract: Constructing domain-specific knowledge graphs from unstructured text remains challenging due to heterogeneous entity mentions, long-tail relation distributions, and the absence of standardized schemas. We present LEC-KG, a bidirectional collaborative framework that integrates the semantic understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) with the structural reasoning of Knowledge Graph Embeddings (KGE). Our approach features three key components: (1) hierarchical coarse-to-fine relation extraction that mitigates long-tail bias, (2) evidence-guided Chain-of-Thought feedback that grounds structural suggestions in source text, and (3) semantic initialization that enables structural validation for unseen entities. The two modules enhance each other iteratively-KGE provides structure-aware feedback to refine LLM extractions, while validated triples progressively improve KGE representations. We evaluate LEC-KG on Chinese Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) reports, demonstrating substantial improvements over LLM baselines, particularly on low-frequency relations. Through iterative refinement, our framework reliably transforms unstructured policy text into validated knowledge graph triples.
zh_title: LEC-KG：一个领域特定知识图谱构建的LLM嵌入协同框架——以SDG为例
translation: 构建领域特定的知识图谱从非结构化文本仍然具有挑战性，因为存在异构的实体提及、长尾的关系分布以及标准化模式的缺失。我们提出了LEC-KG，一个双向协同框架，它整合了大语言模型（LLM）的语义理解和知识图谱嵌入（KGE）的结构推理。我们的方法包含三个关键组成部分：(1) 层级的粗到细的关系抽取，以减轻长尾偏见；(2) 证据引导的思维链反馈，将结构建议 grounding 到源文本；(3) 语义初始化，实现对未见实体的结构验证。这两个模块通过迭代相互增强——KGE为LLM抽取提供结构感知的反馈，而验证后的三元组则逐步改进KGE的表示。我们在中文可持续发展目标（SDG）报告上评估了LEC-KG，结果表明相比于LLM基线有显著改进，尤其是在低频关系方面。通过迭代改进，我们的框架能够可靠地将非结构化政策文本转化为经验证的知识图谱三元组。
tldr: LEC-KG是一个结合LLM和KGE的框架，用于构建领域知识图谱，通过层级关系抽取和证据引导的思维链反馈来解决实体异构和长尾关系问题，并在SDG报告上取得了显著改进。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的LLM-KGE协同框架LEC-KG，用于解决领域特定知识图谱构建中的关键挑战，特别是长尾关系和实体验证问题。其创新的地方在于双向协作机制，KGE为LLM提供结构化反馈，LLM则通过证据引导的思维链反馈来改进KGE。然而，该框架的计算复杂度和可扩展性可能需要进一步研究。
motivation: 从非结构化文本构建领域特定知识图谱面临异构实体提及、长尾关系分布和缺乏标准化模式的挑战。
method: LEC-KG是一个双向协同框架，结合了LLM的语义理解和KGE的结构推理。它包含三个关键组件：(1) 层级粗到细的关系抽取，以减轻长尾偏见；(2) 证据引导的思维链反馈，将结构建议 grounding 到源文本；(3) 语义初始化，实现对未见实体的结构验证。KGE提供结构感知反馈来改进LLM的抽取，而验证后的三元组逐步改进KGE表示。
results: LEC-KG在中文可持续发展目标（SDG）报告上进行了评估，与LLM基线相比，在低频关系上取得了显著改进。该框架能够可靠地将非结构化政策文本转化为经验证的知识图谱三元组。
conclusion: LEC-KG框架通过结合LLM的语义理解和KGE的结构推理，有效地解决了领域特定知识图谱构建中的挑战，尤其是在处理长尾关系和验证实体方面，并在SDG报告的案例研究中证明了其有效性。

title: Mechanized Undecidability of Higher-order beta-Matching (Extended Version)
authors: Andrej Dudenhefner
abstract:
Higher-order beta-matching is the following decision problem: given two simply typed lambda-terms, can the first term be instantiated to be beta-equivalent to the second term? This problem was formulated by Huet in the 1970s and shown undecidable by Loader in 2003 by reduction from lambda-definability.
  The present work provides a novel undecidability proof for higher-order beta-matching, in an effort to verify this result by means of a proof assistant. Rather than starting from lambda-definability, the presented proof encodes a restricted form of string rewriting as higher-order beta-matching. The particular approach is similar to Urzyczyn's undecidability result for intersection type inhabitation.
  The presented approach has several advantages. First, the proof is simpler to verify in full detail due to the simple form of rewriting systems, which serve as a starting point. Second, undecidability of the considered problem in string rewriting is already certified using the Coq proof assistant. As a consequence, we obtain a certified many-one reduction from the Halting Problem to higher-order beta-matching. Third, the presented approach identifies a uniform construction which shows undecidability of higher-order beta-matching, lambda-definability, and intersection type inhabitation.
  The presented undecidability proof is mechanized in the Coq proof assistant and contributed to the existing Coq Library of Undecidability Proofs.
zh_title: 高阶 beta 匹配的机械化不可判定性（扩展版）
translation: 高阶 beta 匹配是以下判定问题：给定两个简单类型的 lambda 项，第一个项是否可以实例化为与第二个项 beta 等价？该问题由 Huet 在 20 世纪 70 年代提出，并由 Loader 在 2003 年通过从 lambda 可定义性进行归约证明为不可判定。本工作提供了一个新的高阶 beta 匹配不可判定性证明，以期通过证明助手来验证该结果。所提出的证明不从 lambda 可定义性开始，而是将一种受限形式的字符串重写编码为高阶 beta 匹配。这种方法与 Urzyczyn 证明交集类型可居住性不可判定性的方法类似。所提出的方法有几个优点。首先，由于作为起点的重写系统的形式简单，该证明更容易被完全验证。其次，所考虑的字符串重写问题不可判定性已经使用 Coq 证明助手进行了认证。因此，我们得到了一个从停机问题到高阶 beta 匹配的认证的许多一归约。第三，所提出的方法识别了一个统一的构造，该构造证明了高阶 beta 匹配、lambda 可定义性和交集类型可居住性的不可判定性。所提出的不可判定性证明在 Coq 证明助手中使用进行了机械化，并为现有的 Coq 不可判定性证明库做出了贡献。
tldr: 该论文提供了一个新的高阶 beta 匹配不可判定性证明，该证明通过将受限的字符串重写编码为高阶 beta 匹配来实现，并使用 Coq 证明助手进行了机械化验证。
ai_comments: 该研究提供了一种新颖的高阶 beta 匹配不可判定性证明方法，通过编码字符串重写来实现，这比传统的从 lambda 可定义性进行归约的方法更易于验证。该研究的贡献在于提供了一个更简单的证明，一个从停机问题到高阶 beta 匹配的许多一归约，以及一个统一的构造，可用于证明相关问题的不可判定性。机械化验证是该研究的一个重要方面，增加了其可靠性。
motivation: 为了通过证明助手验证高阶 beta 匹配的不可判定性结果，并提供一个更简单的证明，可以识别一个统一的构造来证明高阶 beta 匹配、lambda 可定义性和交集类型可居住性的不可判定性。
method: 将受限形式的字符串重写编码为高阶 beta 匹配，并使用 Coq 证明助手进行机械化验证，从而获得从停机问题到高阶 beta 匹配的许多一归约。
results: 提供了一个新的高阶 beta 匹配不可判定性证明，该证明被机械化验证，并为 Coq 不可判定性证明库做出了贡献。该方法还提供了从停机问题到高阶 beta 匹配的许多一归约。
conclusion: 该研究提供了一个新的、可机械化验证的高阶 beta 匹配不可判定性证明，该证明利用了字符串重写，并为未来的研究提供了一个统一的构造。

title: FSVideo: Fast Speed Video Diffusion Model in a Highly-Compressed Latent Space
authors: FSVideo Team, Qingyu Chen, Zhiyuan Fang, Haibin Huang, Xinwei Huang, Tong Jin, Minxuan Lin, Bo Liu, Celong Liu, Chongyang Ma, Xing Mei, Xiaohui Shen, Yaojie Shen, Fuwen Tan, Angtian Wang, Xiao Yang, Yiding Yang, Jiamin Yuan, Lingxi Zhang, Yuxin Zhang
abstract: We introduce FSVideo, a fast speed transformer-based image-to-video (I2V) diffusion framework. We build our framework on the following key components: 1.) a new video autoencoder with highly-compressed latent space ($64\times64\times4$ spatial-temporal downsampling ratio), achieving competitive reconstruction quality; 2.) a diffusion transformer (DIT) architecture with a new layer memory design to enhance inter-layer information flow and context reuse within DIT, and 3.) a multi-resolution generation strategy via a few-step DIT upsampler to increase video fidelity. Our final model, which contains a 14B DIT base model and a 14B DIT upsampler, achieves competitive performance against other popular open-source models, while being an order of magnitude faster. We discuss our model design as well as training strategies in this report.
zh_title: FSVideo：高度压缩潜在空间中的快速视频扩散模型
translation: 我们介绍了FSVideo，一个快速的基于Transformer的图像到视频（I2V）扩散框架。我们的框架建立在以下关键组件之上：1.) 一个具有高度压缩潜在空间（$64\times64\times4$ 空间-时间降采样比）的新型视频自编码器，实现了具有竞争力的重建质量；2.) 一个具有新层记忆设计的扩散Transformer (DIT) 架构，以增强DIT内部的层间信息流和上下文重用；以及 3.) 通过几步DIT上采样器实现的多分辨率生成策略，以提高视频保真度。我们的最终模型包含一个14B DIT基础模型和一个14B DIT上采样器，实现了与流行的开源模型具有竞争力的性能，同时速度快了一个数量级。我们在本报告中讨论了我们的模型设计以及训练策略。
tldr: FSVideo是一个快速的I2V扩散模型，它使用高度压缩的潜在空间和优化的DIT架构（带有层记忆），实现了比现有开源模型快一个数量级的生成速度，并保持了竞争力。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个在高度压缩的潜在空间中运行的快速视频扩散模型，并引入了层记忆设计来优化Transformer的信息流动。其重要性在于显著提高了视频生成速度，同时保持了竞争力。目前来看，论文侧重于模型设计和训练策略的介绍，但未详述具体的局限性。
method: FSVideo框架基于三个关键组件：1) 具有高度压缩潜在空间（$64\times64\times4$ 空间-时间降采样比）的新型视频自编码器；2) 具有新层记忆设计的扩散Transformer (DIT) 架构；3) 通过几步 DIT 上采样器实现的多分辨率生成策略。
results: 最终模型（包含一个14B DIT基础模型和一个14B DIT上采样器）实现了与流行的开源模型具有竞争力的性能，同时速度快了一个数量级。
conclusion: 论文讨论了模型设计和训练策略。

title: Cell-JEPA: Latent Representation Learning for Single-Cell Transcriptomics
authors: Ali ElSheikh, Rui-Xi Wang, Weimin Wu, Yibo Wen, Payam Dibaeinia, Jennifer Yuntong Zhang, Jerry Yao-Chieh Hu, Mei Knudson, Sudarshan Babu, Shao-Hua Sun, Aly A. Khan, Han Liu
abstract: Single-cell foundation models learn by reconstructing masked gene expression, implicitly treating technical noise as signal. With dropout rates exceeding 90%, reconstruction objectives encourage models to encode measurement artifacts rather than stable cellular programs. We introduce Cell-JEPA, a joint-embedding predictive architecture that shifts learning from reconstructing sparse counts to predicting in latent space. The key insight is that cell identity is redundantly encoded across genes. We show predicting cell-level embeddings from partial observations forces the model to learn dropout-robust features. On cell-type clustering, Cell-JEPA achieves 0.72 AvgBIO in zero-shot transfer versus 0.53 for scGPT, a 36% relative improvement. On perturbation prediction within a single cell line, Cell-JEPA improves absolute-state reconstruction but not effect-size estimation, suggesting that representation learning and perturbation modeling address complementary aspects of cellular prediction.
zh_title: Cell-JEPA：单细胞转录组学的潜在表示学习
translation: 单细胞基础模型通过重建掩码基因表达进行学习，但这种方法会隐式地将技术噪声视为信号。由于丢弃率超过90%，重建目标会促使模型编码测量伪影，而非稳定的细胞程序。我们引入了Cell-JEPA，一种联合嵌入预测架构，它将学习从重建稀疏计数转移到在潜在空间中进行预测。关键的见解是细胞身份在基因中是冗余编码的。我们证明了从部分观测值预测细胞级嵌入迫使模型学习对丢弃鲁棒的特征。在细胞类型聚类任务中，Cell-JEPA在零样本迁移中的平均BIO得分为0.72，而scGPT为0.53，相对提高了36%。在单个细胞系内的扰动预测中，Cell-JEPA改善了绝对状态的重建，但并未改善效应大小的估计，这表明表示学习和扰动建模解决了细胞预测的互补方面。
tldr: Cell-JEPA是一种新的单细胞基础模型架构，它通过在潜在空间中预测而不是重建稀疏计数来学习，从而更好地应对高丢弃率，并在下游聚类任务中实现了显著的性能提升。
ai_comments: Cell-JEPA的创新之处在于将学习目标从重建稀疏计数（容易捕获技术噪声）转变为在潜在空间中进行预测，从而更好地学习鲁棒的细胞特征。其重要性在于解决了单细胞数据中高丢弃率带来的挑战。局限性可能在于，虽然它提高了状态重建，但对扰动效应大小的估计能力仍有待提高。
motivation: 现有的单细胞基础模型通过重建掩码基因表达进行学习，无意中将技术噪声（如超过90%的丢弃率）视为信号，从而编码测量伪影而非稳定的细胞程序。
method: Cell-JEPA，一种联合嵌入预测架构，通过从部分观测值预测细胞级嵌入，将学习从重建稀疏计数转移到潜在空间预测。
results: 在细胞类型聚类任务中，Cell-JEPA在零样本迁移中的平均BIO得分为0.72，相比scGPT的0.53，相对提高了36%。在单个细胞系内的扰动预测中，Cell-JEPA改善了绝对状态的重建，但并未改善效应大小的估计。
conclusion: 表示表示学习和扰动建模解决了细胞预测的互补方面。

title: UrbanGS: A Scalable and Efficient Architecture for Geometrically Accurate Large-Scene Reconstruction
authors: Changbai Li, Haodong Zhu, Hanlin Chen, Xiuping Liang, Tongfei Chen, Shuwei Shao, Linlin Yang, Huobin Tan, Baochang Zhang
abstract: While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality, real-time rendering for bounded scenes, its extension to large-scale urban environments gives rise to critical challenges in terms of geometric consistency, memory efficiency, and computational scalability. To address these issues, we present UrbanGS, a scalable reconstruction framework that effectively tackles these challenges for city-scale applications. First, we propose a Depth-Consistent D-Normal Regularization module. Unlike existing approaches that rely solely on monocular normal estimators, which can effectively update rotation parameters yet struggle to update position parameters, our method integrates D-Normal constraints with external depth supervision. This allows for comprehensive updates of all geometric parameters. By further incorporating an adaptive confidence weighting mechanism based on gradient consistency and inverse depth deviation, our approach significantly enhances multi-view depth alignment and geometric coherence, which effectively resolves the issue of geometric accuracy in complex large-scale scenes. To improve scalability, we introduce a Spatially Adaptive Gaussian Pruning (SAGP) strategy, which dynamically adjusts Gaussian density based on local geometric complexity and visibility to reduce redundancy. Additionally, a unified partitioning and view assignment scheme is designed to eliminate boundary artifacts and optimize computational load. Extensive experiments on multiple urban datasets demonstrate that UrbanGS achieves superior performance in rendering quality, geometric accuracy, and memory efficiency, providing a systematic solution for high-fidelity large-scale scene reconstruction.
zh_title: UrbanGS：一种用于几何精确大型场景重建的可扩展高效架构
translation: 虽然3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）能够为有限场景实现高质量的实时渲染，但其向大规模城市环境的扩展在几何一致性、内存效率和计算可扩展性方面带来了严峻挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出了UrbanGS，一个可扩展的重建框架，可有效应对城市规模应用的这些挑战。首先，我们提出了一个深度一致性D-法线正则化模块。与仅依赖单目法线估计器（它们可以有效更新旋转参数但难以更新位置参数）的现有方法不同，我们的方法将D-法线约束与外部深度监督相结合。这使得所有几何参数都能得到全面更新。通过进一步结合基于梯度一致性和反深度偏差的自适应置信度加权机制，我们的方法显著增强了多视图深度对齐和几何一致性，从而有效解决了复杂大场景中的几何精度问题。为了提高可扩展性，我们引入了一种空间自适应高斯剪枝（SAGP）策略，根据局部几何复杂性和可见性动态调整高斯密度以减少冗余。此外，设计了一种统一的分区和视图分配方案，以消除边界伪影并优化计算负载。在多个城市数据集上的广泛实验表明，UrbanGS在渲染质量、几何精度和内存效率方面均实现了卓越的性能，为高保真大规模场景重建提供了一个系统性解决方案。
tldr: UrbanGS通过新的几何正则化方法解决了3DGS在大场景中的几何不一致性，并使用自适应剪枝策略提高了其在城市级重建中的可扩展性和效率。
ai_comments: 该论文的主要创新点在于提出了Depth-Consistent D-Normal Regularization模块来解决大规模场景中的几何一致性问题，并引入了Spatially Adaptive Gaussian Pruning (SAGP)策略来提高可扩展性，这对于城市级三维重建是一个重要的系统性进展。限制在于该方法是针对大规模城市环境的，其通用性可能需要进一步验证。
motivation: 现有的3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）技术在扩展到大规模城市环境时，面临几何一致性、内存效率和计算可扩展性的严峻挑战。
method: 提出Depth-Consistent D-Normal Regularization模块，结合外部深度监督来全面更新几何参数；引入自适应置信度加权机制增强多视图深度对齐；设计Spatially Adaptive Gaussian Pruning (SAGP)策略动态调整高斯密度；设计统一的分区和视图分配方案。
results: UrbanGS在多个城市数据集上实现了优于现有方法的渲染质量、几何精度和内存效率。
conclusion: UrbanGS通过深度一致性法线正则化和自适应高斯剪枝策略，实现了城市级场景的高保真重建，在渲染质量、几何精度和内存效率方面均取得了优越性能。

title: Probabilistic Performance Guarantees for Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning
authors: Yannik Schnitzer, Mathias Jackermeier, Alessandro Abate, David Parker
abstract: Multi-task reinforcement learning trains generalist policies that can execute multiple tasks. While recent years have seen significant progress, existing approaches rarely provide formal performance guarantees, which are indispensable when deploying policies in safety-critical settings. We present an approach for computing high-confidence guarantees on the performance of a multi-task policy on tasks not seen during training. Concretely, we introduce a new generalisation bound that composes (i) per-task lower confidence bounds from finitely many rollouts with (ii) task-level generalisation from finitely many sampled tasks, yielding a high-confidence guarantee for new tasks drawn from the same arbitrary and unknown distribution. Across state-of-the-art multi-task RL methods, we show that the guarantees are theoretically sound and informative at realistic sample sizes.
zh_title: 多任务强化学习的概率性能保证
translation: 多任务强化学习训练出可以执行多个任务的通才策略。尽管近年来取得了重大进展，但现有方法很少提供正式的性能保证，而这在将策略部署到安全关键环境中时是不可或缺的。我们提出了一种计算多任务策略在训练中未见任务上性能的高置信度保证的方法。具体来说，我们引入了一个新的泛化界限，它组合了 (i) 来自有限次滚出的每任务下置信界限和 (ii) 来自有限次采样任务的任务级泛化，从而为从相同任意和未知分布中抽取的新任务提供了高置信度保证。在最先进的多任务强化学习方法中，我们表明这些保证在理论上是合理的，并且在现实的样本规模下具有信息量。
tldr: 为多任务RL策略在未见任务上的性能提供了高置信度的正式保证，通过结合单任务置信度和任务泛化来实现，这对于安全应用很重要。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个组合性的泛化界限，将单任务的置信下界与任务层面的泛化结合起来，为多任务RL在未见任务上的性能提供了高置信度保证，这对于安全关键应用至关重要。然而，其有效性在很大程度上依赖于所选的单任务置信界限和任务采样的分布特性。
motivation: 现有多任务强化学习方法很少提供正式的性能保证，而这种保证对于在安全关键环境中部署策略是不可或缺的。
method: 提出了一种计算多任务策略在新任务上性能的高置信度保证的方法，该方法通过组合 (i) 有限次滚出的每任务下置信界限和 (ii) 有限次采样任务的任务级泛化，来获得针对来自相同任意和未知分布的新任务的保证。
results: 证明了所提出的保证在理论上是合理的，并且在现实的样本规模下具有信息量，并且在最先进的多任务RL方法上进行了验证。

title: Convex limiting for finite elements and its relationship to residual distribution
authors: Dmitri Kuzmin
abstract: We review some recent advances in the field of element-based algebraic stabilization for continuous finite element discretizations of nonlinear hyperbolic problems. The main focus is on multidimensional convex limiting techniques designed to constrain antidiffusive element contributions rather than fluxes. We show that the resulting schemes can be interpreted as residual distribution methods. Two kinds of convex limiting can be used to enforce the validity of generalized discrete maximum principles in this context. The first approach has the structure of a localized flux-corrected transport (FCT) algorithm, in which the computation of a low-order predictor is followed by an antidiffusive correction stage. The second option is the use of a monolithic convex limiting (MCL) procedure at the level of spatial semi-discretization. In both cases, inequality constraints are imposed on scalar functions of intermediate states that are required to stay in convex invariant sets.
zh_title: 有限元的凸限制及其与残差分布的关系
translation: 我们回顾了连续有限元离散化非线性双曲问题的元件基于代数稳定化的最新进展。主要关注旨在限制反扩散单元贡献而非通量的多维凸限制技术。我们证明了所得格式可以被解释为残差分布方法。在这种情况下，可以使用两种凸限制来强制执行广义离散最大值原理。第一种方法具有局部通量校正传输（FCT）算法的结构，其中在计算低阶预测器之后进行反扩散校正阶段。第二种选择是在空间半离散化层面使用单片凸限制（MCL）过程。在这两种情况下，对要求保持在凸不变集中的标量中间状态施加不等式约束。
tldr: 研究了用于非线性双曲问题的有限元稳定化的凸限制技术，发现它与残差分布方法等价，并且可以确保数值解满足最大值原理。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将多维凸限制技术应用于有限元稳定化，并证明了其与残差分布方法的联系。重要性在于提供了一种新的、基于单元的代数稳定化方法来处理非线性双曲问题的数值耗散问题。摘要中未明确提及局限性。
motivation: 解决连续有限元离散化中非线性双曲问题的元件代数稳定化问题，特别是通过限制反扩散单元贡献来约束数值不稳定性。
method: 回顾了多维凸限制技术，分析了两种凸限制方法（局部通量校正传输和单片凸限制）如何应用于空间半离散化，以强制执行标量中间状态的不等式约束。
results: 证明了基于凸限制产生的格式可以被解释为残差分布方法。两种凸限制方法都能在当前背景下强制执行广义离散最大值原理。

title: Think Dense, Not Long: Dynamic Decoupled Conditional Advantage for Efficient Reasoning
authors: Keqin Peng, Yuanxin Ouyang, Xuebo Liu, Zhiliang Tian, Ruijian Han, Yancheng Yuan, Liang Ding
abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) can elicit strong multi-step reasoning, yet it often encourages overly verbose traces. Moreover, naive length penalties in group-relative optimization can severely hurt accuracy. We attribute this failure to two structural issues: (i) Dilution of Length Baseline, where incorrect responses (with zero length reward) depress the group baseline and over-penalize correct solutions; and (ii) Difficulty-Penalty Mismatch, where a static penalty cannot adapt to problem difficulty, suppressing necessary reasoning on hard instances while leaving redundancy on easy ones. We propose Dynamic Decoupled Conditional Advantage (DDCA) to decouple efficiency optimization from correctness. DDCA computes length advantages conditionally within the correct-response cluster to eliminate baseline dilution, and dynamically scales the penalty strength using the group pass rate as a proxy for difficulty. Experiments on GSM8K, MATH500, AMC23, and AIME25 show that DDCA consistently improves the efficiency--accuracy trade-off relative to adaptive baselines, reducing generated tokens by approximately 60% on simpler tasks (e.g., GSM8K) versus over 20% on harder benchmarks (e.g., AIME25), thereby maintaining or improving accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/alphadl/DDCA.
zh_title: 思考密集而非冗长：用于高效推理的动态解耦条件优势
translation: 强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）可以激发强大的多步推理，但通常会鼓励过于冗长的轨迹。此外，群体相对优化中的天真长度惩罚会严重损害准确性。我们将这种失败归因于两个结构性问题：（i）长度基线稀释，其中不正确的响应（零长度奖励）压低了群体基线并过度惩罚了正确的解决方案；和（ii）难度-惩罚不匹配，其中静态惩罚无法适应问题难度，在困难实例上抑制了必要的推理，而在简单实例上留下了冗余。我们提出动态解耦条件优势（DDCA）来使效率优化与正确性解耦。DDCA在正确响应集群内有条件地计算长度优势，以消除基线稀释，并使用组通过率作为难度的代理来动态缩放惩罚强度。在GSM8K、MATH500、AMC23和AIME25上的实验表明，DDCA相对于自适应基线一致地改善了效率-准确率的权衡，在简单任务（如GSM8K）上减少了约60%的生成token，而在更难的基准（如AIME25）上减少了20%以上，从而保持或提高了准确性。代码可在https://github.com/alphadl/DDCA获取。
tldr: RLVR方法推理太啰嗦，简单惩罚会误伤好答案。DDCA方法通过聪明地计算长度奖励（只在正确答案中算）和动态调整惩罚力度，成功地让模型推理得又快又准，减少了60%以上的冗余文本。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地提出了DDCA方法，解决了RLVR中因长度惩罚不当导致的冗长推理问题，通过条件计算和动态缩放解决了基线稀释和难度惩罚不匹配的结构性难题。其核心贡献在于实现了效率和准确性的有效解耦，并在多个数学推理基准上取得了显著的效率提升，同时保持甚至提高了准确性。
motivation: 强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）虽然能激发多步推理，但容易导致推理过程过于冗长；而简单的长度惩罚在群体相对优化中会严重损害准确性，原因是（i）错误响应（零长度奖励）稀释了长度基线，过度惩罚了正确解；和（ii）静态惩罚无法适应问题难度，导致在难任务上抑制了必要的推理，而在易任务上留下了冗余。
method: 提出动态解耦条件优势（DDCA），通过在正确响应集群内有条件地计算长度优势来消除基线稀释，并使用组通过率作为难度代理来动态缩放惩罚强度，从而将效率优化与正确性优化解耦。
results: 实验结果表明，DDCA相对于自适应基线，一致地改善了效率-准确率的权衡。在简单任务（如GSM8K）上，生成的token减少了约60%；在更难的基准（如AIME25）上，减少了20%以上，同时保持或提高了准确性。
conclusion: DDCA通过有条件地计算长度优势和动态调整惩罚力度，成功地将效率优化与正确性分离开来，在多个数学推理基准上显著提高了效率-准确率的权衡，有效减少了不必要的冗长推理，同时保持或提高了准确性。

title: No Global Plan in Chain-of-Thought: Uncover the Latent Planning Horizon of LLMs
authors: Liyan Xu, Mo Yu, Fandong Meng, Jie Zhou
abstract: This work stems from prior complementary observations on the dynamics of Chain-of-Thought (CoT): Large Language Models (LLMs) is shown latent planning of subsequent reasoning prior to CoT emergence, thereby diminishing the significance of explicit CoT; whereas CoT remains critical for tasks requiring multi-step reasoning. To deepen the understanding between LLM's internal states and its verbalized reasoning trajectories, we investigate the latent planning strength of LLMs, through our probing method, Tele-Lens, applying to hidden states across diverse task domains. Our empirical results indicate that LLMs exhibit a myopic horizon, primarily conducting incremental transitions without precise global planning. Leveraging this characteristic, we propose a hypothesis on enhancing uncertainty estimation of CoT, which we validate that a small subset of CoT positions can effectively represent the uncertainty of the entire path. We further underscore the significance of exploiting CoT dynamics, and demonstrate that automatic recognition of CoT bypass can be achieved without performance degradation. Our code, data and models are released at https://github.com/lxucs/tele-lens.
zh_title: 思维链中没有全局规划：揭示大型语言模型的潜在规划范围
translation: 这项工作源于先前关于思维链（CoT）动态的互补观察：大型语言模型（LLM）在CoT出现之前就表现出对后续推理的潜在规划，从而降低了显式CoT的重要性；然而，对于需要多步推理的任务，CoT仍然至关重要。为了加深对LLM内部状态与其言语推理轨迹之间关系的理解，我们通过我们的探测方法Tele-Lens，应用于跨领域任务的隐藏状态，来研究LLM的潜在规划强度。我们的实证结果表明，LLM表现出近视范围，主要进行增量转换而没有精确的全局规划。利用这一特性，我们提出了一个关于增强CoT不确定性估计的假设，我们验证了少量CoT位置可以有效地代表整个路径的不确定性。我们进一步强调了利用CoT动态的重要性，并证明了可以在不降低性能的情况下自动识别CoT旁路。我们的代码、数据和模型发布在https://github.com/lxucs/tele-lens。
tldr: 研究发现LLM的思维链（CoT）推理中存在“近视”的潜在规划，主要进行逐步推理而非全局规划。利用这一发现，作者提出了一种方法来更好地估计CoT路径的不确定性，并展示了如何有效利用CoT的动态特性。
ai_comments: 这项工作通过引入“Tele-Lens”探测方法，深入探究了大型语言模型（LLM）在思维链（CoT）推理中潜在的规划范围。研究发现LLM具有“近视”规划的特点，主要依赖增量转换而非全局规划，这对理解和改进CoT的性能具有重要意义。该研究的创新点在于量化了潜在规划范围，并提出了利用CoT动态的实用方法。
motivation: 源于先前的互补观察，即LLM在CoT出现前就表现出潜在规划，从而削弱了显式CoT的重要性；然而，CoT对于需要多步推理的任务仍然至关重要。研究旨在加深对LLM内部状态与其言语推理轨迹之间关系的理解。
method: 提出了一种名为“Tele-Lens”的探测方法，用于探查跨领域任务中隐藏状态的潜在规划强度。此方法用于研究LLM在CoT推理中先于言语推理出现的潜在规划的范围。
results: 实证结果表明，LLM表现出近视规划范围，主要进行增量转换而没有精确的全局规划。研究验证了少量CoT位置可以有效地代表整个路径的不确定性。此外，研究证明了可以在不损失性能的情况下自动识别CoT旁路。
conclusion: 研究揭示了LLM在推理过程中表现出近视规划的特性，主要依赖增量转换而非精确的全局规划。基于此特性，研究提出了增强CoT不确定性估计的假设，并验证了少量CoT位置即可有效代表整个推理路径的不确定性。同时，研究强调了利用CoT动态的重要性，并展示了在不损失性能的情况下自动识别CoT旁路的可行性。

title: Dicta-LM 3.0: Advancing The Frontier of Hebrew Sovereign LLMs
authors: Shaltiel Shmidman, Avi Shmidman, Amir DN Cohen, Moshe Koppel
abstract: Open-weight LLMs have been released by frontier labs; however, sovereign Large Language Models (for languages other than English) remain low in supply yet high in demand. Training large language models (LLMs) for low-resource languages such as Hebrew poses unique challenges. In this paper, we introduce Dicta-LM 3.0: an open-weight collection of LLMs trained on substantially-sized corpora of Hebrew and English texts. The model is released in three sizes: 24B - adapted from the Mistral-Small-3.1 base model, 12B - adapted from the NVIDIA Nemotron Nano V2 model, and 1.7B - adapted from the Qwen3-1.7B base model. We are releasing multiple variants of each model, each with a native context length of 65k tokens; base model and chat model with tool-calling support. To rigorously evaluate our models, we introduce a new benchmark suite for evaluation of Hebrew chat-LLMs, covering a diverse set of tasks including Translation, Summarization, Winograd, Israeli Trivia, and Diacritization (nikud). Our work not only addresses the intricacies of training LLMs in low-resource languages but also proposes a framework that can be leveraged for adapting other LLMs to various non-English languages, contributing to the broader field of multilingual NLP.

title: The Verification Crisis: Expert Perceptions of GenAI Disinformation and the Case for Reproducible Provenance
authors: Alexander Loth, Martin Kappes, Marc-Oliver Pahl
abstract:
The growth of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) has shifted disinformation production from manual fabrication to automated, large-scale manipulation. This article presents findings from the first wave of a longitudinal expert perception survey (N=21) involving AI researchers, policymakers, and disinformation specialists. It examines the perceived severity of multimodal threats -- text, image, audio, and video -- and evaluates current mitigation strategies.
  Results indicate that while deepfake video presents immediate "shock" value, large-scale text generation poses a systemic risk of "epistemic fragmentation" and "synthetic consensus," particularly in the political domain. The survey reveals skepticism about technical detection tools, with experts favoring provenance standards and regulatory frameworks despite implementation barriers.
  GenAI disinformation research requires reproducible methods. The current challenge is measurement: without standardized benchmarks and reproducibility checklists, tracking or countering synthetic media remains difficult. We propose treating information integrity as an infrastructure with rigor in data provenance and methodological reproducibility.
zh_title: 验证危机：专家对生成式人工智能虚假信息的看法及可复现溯源的必要性
translation: 生成式人工智能（GenAI）的增长已将虚假信息的生产从手动伪造转变为自动化、大规模的操纵。本文介绍了对人工智能研究人员、政策制定者和虚假信息专家（N=21）进行的纵向专家感知调查的第一阶段结果。它考察了对多模态威胁——文本、图像、音频和视频——的感知严重性，并评估了当前的缓解策略。结果表明，虽然深度伪造视频具有即时的“冲击”价值，但大规模文本生成带来了“认识碎片化”和“合成共识”的系统性风险，尤其是在政治领域。调查显示专家对技术检测工具持怀疑态度，尽管存在实施障碍，但他们更倾向于溯源标准和监管框架。GenAI虚假信息研究需要可复现的方法。目前的挑战在于测量：没有标准化的基准和可复现性检查清单，跟踪或对抗合成媒体仍然很困难。我们建议将信息完整性视为一种基础设施，在数据溯源和方法论可复现性方面保持严谨。
tldr: GenAI正在大规模制造虚假信息，专家认为文本风险大于视频冲击，技术检测靠不住，急需溯源标准和监管，而且所有相关研究都必须是可复现的。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于其对GenAI虚假信息威胁的纵向专家调查视角，并强调了在研究方法上实现可复现性的关键性，将其视为信息完整性基础设施的一部分。其局限性可能在于样本量较小（N=21），代表性有限。
motivation: GenAI已将虚假信息生产转变为自动化、大规模的操纵，需要了解专家对多模态威胁的感知和对现有缓解策略的评估。
method: 一项针对AI研究人员、政策制定者和虚假信息专家的纵向专家感知调查的第一波（N=21）。
results: 深伪视频具有即时的“冲击”价值，但大规模文本生成在政治领域带来了“认识碎片化”和“合成共识”的系统性风险。专家对技术检测工具持怀疑态度，更青睐溯源标准和监管框架。
conclusion: 专家们对技术检测工具持怀疑态度，更倾向于采用溯源标准和监管框架来应对GenAI虚假信息，并且强调了研究方法的可复现性对于有效应对合成媒体至关重要。

title: Teacher-Guided Student Self-Knowledge Distillation Using Diffusion Model
authors: Yu Wang, Chuanguang Yang, Zhulin An, Weilun Feng, Jiarui Zhao, Chengqing Yu, Libo Huang, Boyu Diao, Yongjun Xu
abstract: Existing Knowledge Distillation (KD) methods often align feature information between teacher and student by exploring meaningful feature processing and loss functions. However, due to the difference in feature distributions between the teacher and student, the student model may learn incompatible information from the teacher. To address this problem, we propose teacher-guided student Diffusion Self-KD, dubbed as DSKD. Instead of the direct teacher-student alignment, we leverage the teacher classifier to guide the sampling process of denoising student features through a light-weight diffusion model. We then propose a novel locality-sensitive hashing (LSH)-guided feature distillation method between the original and denoised student features. The denoised student features encapsulate teacher knowledge and could be regarded as a teacher role. In this way, our DSKD method could eliminate discrepancies in mapping manners and feature distributions between the teacher and student, while learning meaningful knowledge from the teacher. Experiments on visual recognition tasks demonstrate that DSKD significantly outperforms existing KD methods across various models and datasets. Our code is attached in supplementary material.
zh_title: 教师引导的基于扩散模型的学生自知识蒸馏
translation: 现有的知识蒸馏（KD）方法通常通过探索有意义的特征处理和损失函数来对齐师生之间的特征信息。然而，由于师生特征分布的差异，学生模型可能从教师那里学到不兼容的信息。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了教师引导的学生扩散自知识蒸馏，简称DSKD。我们没有直接进行师生对齐，而是利用教师分类器来指导一个轻量级的扩散模型对去噪学生特征进行采样过程。然后，我们提出了一种新颖的局部敏感哈希（LSH）引导的特征蒸馏方法，用于原始学生特征和去噪学生特征之间。去噪的学生特征封装了教师知识，可以被视为扮演教师的角色。通过这种方式，我们的DSKD方法可以在学习有意义知识的同时，消除师生在映射方式和特征分布上的差异。在视觉识别任务上的实验证明，DSKD在各种模型和数据集上显著优于现有的KD方法。我们的代码附在补充材料中。
tldr: DSKD使用扩散模型和教师分类器来“净化”学生特征，生成一个更像教师的特征表示，然后用这个“净化后”的特征来指导学生学习，避免了直接对齐时特征分布不匹配的问题，效果比现有方法好。
ai_comments: 该方法创新性地将扩散模型引入知识蒸馏（KD）领域，用于指导学生特征的去噪过程，解决了传统KD中特征分布不匹配的问题。其核心思想是让去噪后的学生特征扮演“教师”角色，从而实现更平滑的知识迁移。实验结果表明了其优越性。
motivation: 现有知识蒸馏（KD）方法通过特征处理和损失函数对齐师生特征，但由于师生特征分布的差异，学生模型可能学习到不兼容的信息。为了解决这一问题，需要一种新的机制来消除这种差异。
method: 提出了一种名为DSKD（Teacher-Guided Student Diffusion Self-KD）的方法，它不直接进行师生特征对齐，而是利用教师分类器指导一个轻量级的扩散模型对学生特征进行去噪采样。随后，提出了一种新颖的局部敏感哈希（LSH）引导的特征蒸馏方法，用于在原始学生特征和去噪后的学生特征之间进行蒸馏。去噪后的学生特征被视为新的“教师”角色。
results: 实验在视觉识别任务上进行，结果表明DSKD在各种模型和数据集上显著优于现有的知识蒸馏方法。
conclusion: DSKD方法通过利用教师分类器指导扩散模型去噪学生特征，并引入LSH引导的特征蒸馏，有效消除了师生模型在映射方式和特征分布上的差异，显著优于现有KD方法。

title: Out of the Memory Barrier: A Highly Memory Efficient Training System for LLMs with Million-Token Contexts
authors: Wenhao Li, Daohai Yu, Gen Luo, Yuxin Zhang, Fei Chao, Rongrong Ji, Yifan Wu, Jiaxin Liu, Ziyang Gong, Zimu Liao
abstract: Training Large Language Models (LLMs) on long contexts is severely constrained by prohibitive GPU memory overhead, not training time. The primary culprits are the activations, whose memory footprints scale linearly with sequence length. We introduce OOMB, a highly memory-efficient training system that directly confronts this barrier. Our approach employs a chunk-recurrent training framework with on-the-fly activation recomputation, which maintains a constant activation memory footprint (O(1)) and shifts the primary bottleneck to the growing KV cache. To manage the KV cache, OOMB integrates a suite of synergistic optimizations: a paged memory manager for both the KV cache and its gradients to eliminate fragmentation, asynchronous CPU offloading to hide data transfer latency, and page-level sparse attention to reduce both computational complexity and communication overhead. The synergy of these techniques yields exceptional efficiency. Our empirical results show that for every additional 10K tokens of context, the end-to-end training memory overhead increases by a mere 10MB for Qwen2.5-7B. This allows training Qwen2.5-7B with a 4M-token context on a single H200 GPU, a feat that would otherwise require a large cluster using context parallelism. This work represents a substantial advance in resource efficiency for long-context LLM training. The source code is available at https://github.com/wenhaoli-xmu/OOMB.
zh_title: 内存屏障之外：一个用于具有百万令牌上下文的大型语言模型的高内存效率训练系统
translation: 训练大型语言模型（LLM）处理长上下文会因巨大的GPU内存开销而受到严重限制，而非训练时间。主要原因是激活的内存占用随序列长度呈线性增长。我们引入了OOMB，一个直接应对这一障碍的高内存效率训练系统。我们的方法采用了分块循环训练框架和动态激活重计算，将激活的内存占用保持为恒定（O(1)），并将主要瓶颈转移到不断增长的KV缓存。为了管理KV缓存，OOMB整合了一系列协同优化：用于KV缓存及其梯度的分页内存管理器，以消除碎片；异步CPU卸载，以隐藏数据传输延迟；以及页级稀疏注意力，以减少计算复杂性和通信开销。这些技术的协同作用带来了卓越的效率。我们的实证结果表明，对于每增加10K令牌的上下文，Qwen2.5-7B的端到端训练内存开销仅增加10MB。这使得在单个H200 GPU上训练具有4M令牌上下文的Qwen2.5-7B成为可能，而这在其他情况下需要使用上下文并行化的大型集群。这项工作代表了长上下文LLM训练资源效率方面的重大进步。源代码可在https://github.com/wenhaoli-xmu/OOMB获取。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为OOMB的训练系统，通过分块循环和动态重计算激活来解决LLM长上下文训练中的内存瓶颈，并将KV缓存管理作为主要优化目标，实现了极高的内存效率，使得在单GPU上训练具有4M令牌上下文的模型成为可能。
ai_comments: 该研究提出的OOMB系统在解决LLM长上下文训练的内存效率问题上取得了显著突破。通过将激活内存占用降至O(1)并有效管理KV缓存，该系统极大地降低了对计算资源的需求，使得以前难以想象的超长上下文训练成为可能。其在Qwen2.5-7B模型上实现的低内存增长率和单GPU训练4M上下文的能力尤为令人印象深刻。该研究的创新性在于其多种优化技术的协同应用，提供了一个实际可行的解决方案。唯一的潜在局限性可能是CPU卸载和稀疏注意力在某些特定场景下的性能表现，但这并不影响其整体的开创性贡献。
motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）在长上下文上的训练受到GPU内存开销的严重限制，而非训练时间。激活的内存占用随序列长度线性增长是主要原因。
method: 提出了一种名为OOMB的内存高效训练系统，采用分块循环训练框架和动态激活重计算，将激活内存占用保持为O(1)，并将KV缓存管理作为主要优化目标。通过整合分页内存管理器、异步CPU卸载和页级稀疏注意力来优化KV缓存。
results: 对于每增加10K令牌的上下文，Qwen2.5-7B的端到端训练内存开销仅增加10MB。这使得在单H200 GPU上训练具有4M令牌上下文的Qwen2.5-7B成为可能。
conclusion: OOMB系统在资源效率方面取得了重大进展，为长上下文LLM训练提供了解决方案，显著降低了内存开销，使得在有限资源下处理超长上下文成为可能。

title: An Empirical Study of World Model Quantization
authors: Zhongqian Fu, Tianyi Zhao, Kai Han, Hang Zhou, Xinghao Chen, Yunhe Wang
abstract: World models learn an internal representation of environment dynamics, enabling agents to simulate and reason about future states within a compact latent space for tasks such as planning, prediction, and inference. However, running world models rely on hevay computational cost and memory footprint, making model quantization essential for efficient deployment. To date, the effects of post-training quantization (PTQ) on world models remain largely unexamined. In this work, we present a systematic empirical study of world model quantization using DINO-WM as a representative case, evaluating diverse PTQ methods under both weight-only and joint weight-activation settings. We conduct extensive experiments on different visual planning tasks across a wide range of bit-widths, quantization granularities, and planning horizons up to 50 iterations. Our results show that quantization effects in world models extend beyond standard accuracy and bit-width trade-offs: group-wise weight quantization can stabilize low-bit rollouts, activation quantization granularity yields inconsistent benefits, and quantization sensitivity is highly asymmetric between encoder and predictor modules. Moreover, aggressive low-bit quantization significantly degrades the alignment between the planning objective and task success, leading to failures that cannot be remedied by additional optimization. These findings reveal distinct quantization-induced failure modes in world model-based planning and provide practical guidance for deploying quantized world models under strict computational constraints. The code will be available at https://github.com/huawei-noah/noah-research/tree/master/QuantWM.
zh_title: 世界模型量化的实证研究
translation: 世界模型学习环境动态的内部表示，使智能体能够在紧凑的潜在空间中模拟和推理未来状态，以实现规划、预测和推理等任务。然而，运行世界模型依赖于沉重的计算成本和内存占用，使得模型量化对于高效部署至关重要。迄今为止，训练后量化（PTQ）对世界模型的影响在很大程度上仍未被检验。在这项工作中，我们使用 DINO-WM 作为代表案例，对世界模型量化进行了系统的实证研究，评估了在仅权重和联合权重-激活设置下的各种 PTQ 方法。我们对不同比特宽度、量化粒度和高达 50 次迭代的规划视野下的不同视觉规划任务进行了广泛的实验。我们的结果表明，世界模型中的量化效应超出了标准的精度和比特宽度权衡：组级权重量化可以稳定低比特滚回，激活量化粒度产生的益处不一致，并且量化敏感性在编码器和预测器模块之间高度不对称。此外，激进的低比特量化会严重损害规划目标与任务成功之间的一致性，导致无法通过额外优化来弥补的失败。这些发现揭示了世界模型基于规划中独特的量化诱导的失效模式，并为在严格的计算约束下部署量化世界模型提供了实用的指导。代码将在 https://github.com/huawei-noah/noah-research/tree/master/QuantWM 上提供。
tldr: 对世界模型（以 DINO-WM 为例）的训练后量化（PTQ）进行了实证研究，发现量化对规划性能的影响复杂，并揭示了不同模块的量化敏感性差异，低比特量化可能导致规划失败，为高效部署提供了指导。
ai_comments: 这项工作对世界模型的量化进行了系统的实证研究，重点关注了其对规划性能的独特影响，而不仅仅是标准精度指标。发现量化敏感性在编码器和预测器之间存在显著不对称性，这是一个重要的见解。其局限性在于仅使用 DINO-WM 作为代表案例，可能无法完全概括所有世界模型。
motivation: 世界模型具有沉重的计算成本和内存占用，阻碍了其高效部署，因此模型量化变得至关重要，但现有的关于世界模型后训练量化 (PTQ) 的影响的研究很少。
method: 对 DINO-WM 进行了系统的实证研究，评估了不同的训练后量化 (PTQ) 方法，包括仅权重和联合权重-激活设置，并在不同的比特宽度、量化粒度和规划视野下进行了实验。
results: 研究结果表明，量化对世界模型的影响超出了标准的精度和比特宽度权衡：组级权重量化可以稳定低比特的滚回（rollouts），激活量化粒度带来的益处不一致，并且量化敏感性在编码器和预测器模块之间高度不对称。此外，激进的低比特量化会严重损害规划目标与任务成功之间的一致性。
conclusion: 研究结果揭示了世界模型基于规划中独特的量化诱导的失效模式，并为在严格的计算约束下部署量化世界模型提供了实用的指导。

title: Enhancing Diffusion-Based Quantitatively Controllable Image Generation via Matrix-Form EDM and Adaptive Vicinal Training
authors: Xin Ding, Yun Chen, Sen Zhang, Kao Zhang, Nenglun Chen, Peibei Cao, Yongwei Wang, Fei Wu
abstract: Continuous Conditional Diffusion Model (CCDM) is a diffusion-based framework designed to generate high-quality images conditioned on continuous regression labels. Although CCDM has demonstrated clear advantages over prior approaches across a range of datasets, it still exhibits notable limitations and has recently been surpassed by a GAN-based method, namely CcGAN-AVAR. These limitations mainly arise from its reliance on an outdated diffusion framework and its low sampling efficiency due to long sampling trajectories. To address these issues, we propose an improved CCDM framework, termed iCCDM, which incorporates the more advanced \textit{Elucidated Diffusion Model} (EDM) framework with substantial modifications to improve both generation quality and sampling efficiency. Specifically, iCCDM introduces a novel matrix-form EDM formulation together with an adaptive vicinal training strategy. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets, spanning image resolutions from $64\times64$ to $256\times256$, demonstrate that iCCDM consistently outperforms existing methods, including state-of-the-art large-scale text-to-image diffusion models (e.g., Stable Diffusion 3, FLUX.1, and Qwen-Image), achieving higher generation quality while significantly reducing sampling cost.
zh_title: 通过矩阵形式的EDM和自适应邻近训练增强基于扩散的可定量控制的图像生成
translation: 连续条件扩散模型（CCDM）是一个基于扩散的框架，旨在根据连续回归标签生成高质量图像。尽管CCDM在各种数据集上显示出优于先前方法的明显优势，但它仍然存在明显的局限性，并且最近已被一种名为CcGAN-AVAR的基于GAN的方法超越。这些局限性主要源于其对过时扩散框架的依赖以及由于采样轨迹长而导致的低采样效率。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一个改进的CCDM框架，称为iCCDM，它结合了更先进的阐明扩散模型（EDM）框架，并对关键部分进行了大量修改，以提高生成质量和采样效率。具体来说，iCCDM引入了一种新颖的矩阵形式EDM公式以及一种自适应邻近训练策略。在跨越从$64\times64$到$256\times256$图像分辨率的四个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，iCCDM持续优于现有方法，包括最先进的大规模文本到图像扩散模型（例如，Stable Diffusion 3、FLUX.1和Qwen-Image），实现了更高的生成质量，同时显著降低了采样成本。
tldr: 研究人员改进了连续条件扩散模型（CCDM），创建了iCCDM，它采用了矩阵形式的EDM和自适应训练策略。iCCDM在图像生成质量上超越了现有技术（包括大型文生图模型），同时大幅提高了采样速度。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于结合了EDM框架和矩阵形式的EDM公式以及自适应邻近训练策略，以解决现有连续条件扩散模型（CCDM）在生成质量和采样效率上的不足。其重要性在于在连续条件图像生成任务上超越了包括SOTA文本到图像模型在内的现有方法。限制方面，虽然提出了改进，但原始CCDM的局限性主要源于其依赖过时的扩散框架和低采样效率。
motivation: 现有CCDM框架在生成质量和采样效率上存在局限性，主要是因为它依赖于过时的扩散框架和具有较长采样轨迹导致的低采样效率，并且已被基于GAN的方法（CcGAN-AVAR）超越。
method: 提出iCCDM框架，该框架整合了更先进的EDM框架，并引入了新颖的矩阵形式EDM公式和自适应邻近训练策略来改进生成质量和采样效率。
results: iCCDM在从$64\times64$到$256\times256$的四个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，iCCDM持续优于现有方法，包括最先进的大规模文本到图像扩散模型（如Stable Diffusion 3, FLUX.1和Qwen-Image），实现了更高的生成质量并显著降低了采样成本。
conclusion: iCCDM框架通过引入矩阵形式的EDM公式和自适应邻近训练策略，在保持或提高生成质量的同时，显著降低了采样成本，并在多个基准数据集上超越了现有方法。

title: The Maximum von Neumann Entropy Principle: Theory and Applications in Machine Learning
authors: Youqi Wu, Farzan Farnia
abstract: Von Neumann entropy (VNE) is a fundamental quantity in quantum information theory and has recently been adopted in machine learning as a spectral measure of diversity for kernel matrices and kernel covariance operators. While maximizing VNE under constraints is well known in quantum settings, a principled analogue of the classical maximum entropy framework, particularly its decision theoretic and game theoretic interpretation, has not been explicitly developed for VNE in data driven contexts. In this paper, we extend the minimax formulation of the maximum entropy principle due to Grünwald and Dawid to the setting of von Neumann entropy, providing a game-theoretic justification for VNE maximization over density matrices and trace-normalized positive semidefinite operators. This perspective yields a robust interpretation of maximum VNE solutions under partial information and clarifies their role as least committed inferences in spectral domains. We then illustrate how the resulting Maximum VNE principle applies to modern machine learning problems by considering two representative applications, selecting a kernel representation from multiple normalized embeddings via kernel-based VNE maximization, and completing kernel matrices from partially observed entries. These examples demonstrate how the proposed framework offers a unifying information-theoretic foundation for VNE-based methods in kernel learning.

title: Convergence of a least-squares splitting method for the Monge-Ampère equation
authors: Anna Peruso, Massimo Sorella
abstract: We study the theoretical convergence of the nonlinear least-squares splitting method for the Monge-Ampère equation in which each iteration decouples the pointwise nonlinearity from the differential operator and consists of a local nonlinear update followed by the solution of two sequential Poisson-type elliptic problems. While the method performs well in computations, a rigorous convergence theory has remained unavailable. We observe that the iteration admits a reformulation as an alternating-projection scheme on Sobolev spaces $H^m$, $m\ge 0$. At a solution, the Gâteaux differentials of the projection maps are the linear projections onto the corresponding tangent spaces. We prove that these tangent spaces are transverse, and hence the linearization of the alternating-projection map is a contraction by classical Hilbert-space theory for alternating projections. Building on this geometric characterization, we prove linear convergence in $H^2$ of the splitting method on the two-dimensional torus $\mathbb{T}^2$ for initial data sufficiently close to a solution $u\in H^4$. To the best of our knowledge, this yields the first rigorous convergence result for this splitting method in the periodic setting and provides a functional-analytic explanation for its observed numerical robustness.

title: CHAOS: Controlled Hardware fAult injectOr System for gem5
authors: Elio Vinciguerra, Enrico Russo, Giuseppe Ascia, Maurizio Palesi
abstract: Fault injectors are essential tools for evaluating the reliability and resilience of computing systems. They enable the simulation of hardware and software faults to analyze system behavior under error conditions and assess its ability to operate correctly despite disruptions. Such analysis is critical for identifying vulnerabilities and improving system robustness. CHAOS is a modular, open-source, and fully configurable fault injection framework designed for the gem5 simulator. It facilitates precise and systematic fault injection across multiple architectural levels, supporting comprehensive evaluations of fault tolerance mechanisms and resilience strategies. Its high configurability and seamless integration with gem5 allow researchers to explore a wide range of fault models and complex scenarios, making CHAOS a valuable tool for advancing research in dependable and high-performance computing systems.

title: Unifying Masked Diffusion Models with Various Generation Orders and Beyond
authors: Chunsan Hong, Sanghyun Lee, Jong Chul Ye
abstract: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) are a potential alternative to autoregressive models (ARMs) for language generation, but generation quality depends critically on the generation order. Prior work either hard-codes an ordering (e.g., blockwise left-to-right) or learns an ordering policy for a pretrained MDM, which incurs extra cost and can yield suboptimal solutions due to the two-stage optimization. Motivated by this, we propose order-expressive masked diffusion model (OeMDM) for a broad class of diffusion generative processes with various generation orders, enabling the interpretation of MDM, ARM, and block diffusion in a single framework. Furthermore, building on OeMDM, we introduce learnable-order masked diffusion model (LoMDM), which jointly learns the generation ordering and diffusion backbone through a single objective from scratch, enabling the diffusion model to generate text in context-dependent ordering. Empirically, we confirm that LoMDM outperforms various discrete diffusion models across multiple language modeling benchmarks.
zh_title: 统一掩码扩散模型与各种生成顺序及超越
translation: 掩码扩散模型（MDMs）是自回归模型（ARMs）在语言生成方面的一个潜在替代方案，但生成质量严重依赖于生成顺序。先前的工作要么硬编码一个顺序（例如，块状左到右），要么为预训练的MDM学习一个顺序策略，这会产生额外的成本，并且由于两阶段优化可能产生次优解。受此启发，我们提出了顺序表达掩码扩散模型（OeMDM），用于广泛的具有各种生成顺序的扩散生成过程，从而在一个框架内实现MDM、ARM和块扩散的解释。此外，在OeMDM的基础上，我们引入了可学习顺序掩码扩散模型（LoMDM），它通过单一目标从头开始联合学习生成顺序和扩散骨干，使扩散模型能够以上下文依赖的顺序生成文本。实证研究证实，LoMDM在多个语言建模基准测试中优于各种离散扩散模型。

title: MLV-Edit: Towards Consistent and Highly Efficient Editing for Minute-Level Videos
authors: Yangyi Cao, Yuanhang Li, Lan Chen, Qi Mao
abstract: We propose MLV-Edit, a training-free, flow-based framework that address the unique challenges of minute-level video editing. While existing techniques excel in short-form video manipulation, scaling them to long-duration videos remains challenging due to prohibitive computational overhead and the difficulty of maintaining global temporal consistency across thousands of frames. To address this, MLV-Edit employs a divide-and-conquer strategy for segment-wise editing, facilitated by two core modules: Velocity Blend rectifies motion inconsistencies at segment boundaries by aligning the flow fields of adjacent chunks, eliminating flickering and boundary artifacts commonly observed in fragmented video processing; and Attention Sink anchors local segment features to global reference frames, effectively suppressing cumulative structural drift. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that MLV-Edit consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of temporal stability and semantic fidelity.

title: TriCloudEdge: A multi-layer Cloud Continuum
authors: George Violettas, Lefteris Mamatas
abstract: TriCloudEdge is a scalable three-tier cloud continuum that integrates far-edge devices, intermediate edge nodes, and central cloud services, working in parallel as a unified solution. At the far edge, ultra-low-cost microcontrollers can handle lightweight AI tasks, while intermediate edge devices provide local intelligence, and the cloud tier offers large-scale analytics, federated learning, model adaptation, and global identity management. The proposed architecture enables multi-protocols and technologies (WebSocket, MQTT, HTTP) compared to a versatile protocol (Zenoh) to transfer diverse bidirectional data across the tiers, offering a balance between computational challenges and latency requirements. Comparative implementations between these two architectures demonstrate the trade-offs between resource utilization and communication efficiency. The results show that TriCloudEdge can distribute computational challenges to address latency and privacy concerns. The work also presents tests of AI model adaptation on the far edge and the computational effort challenges under the prism of parallelism. This work offers a perspective on the practical continuum challenges of implementation aligned with recent research advances addressing challenges across the different cloud levels.

title: Toxicity Assessment in Preclinical Histopathology via Class-Aware Mahalanobis Distance for Known and Novel Anomalies
authors: Olga Graf, Dhrupal Patel, Peter Groß, Charlotte Lempp, Matthias Hein, Fabian Heinemann
abstract: Drug-induced toxicity remains a leading cause of failure in preclinical development and early clinical trials. Detecting adverse effects at an early stage is critical to reduce attrition and accelerate the development of safe medicines. Histopathological evaluation remains the gold standard for toxicity assessment, but it relies heavily on expert pathologists, creating a bottleneck for large-scale screening. To address this challenge, we introduce an AI-based anomaly detection framework for histopathological whole-slide images (WSIs) in rodent livers from toxicology studies. The system identifies healthy tissue and known pathologies (anomalies) for which training data is available. In addition, it can detect rare pathologies without training data as out-of-distribution (OOD) findings. We generate a novel dataset of pixelwise annotations of healthy tissue and known pathologies and use this data to fine-tune a pre-trained Vision Transformer (DINOv2) via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) in order to do tissue segmentation. Finally, we extract features for OOD detection using the Mahalanobis distance. To better account for class-dependent variability in histological data, we propose the use of class-specific thresholds. We optimize the thresholds using the mean of the false negative and false positive rates, resulting in only 0.16\% of pathological tissue classified as healthy and 0.35\% of healthy tissue classified as pathological. Applied to mouse liver WSIs with known toxicological findings, the framework accurately detects anomalies, including rare OOD morphologies. This work demonstrates the potential of AI-driven histopathology to support preclinical workflows, reduce late-stage failures, and improve efficiency in drug development.

title: Two-Stage Grid Optimization for Group-wise Quantization of LLMs
authors: Junhan Kim, Gukryeol Lee, Seungwoo Son, Jeewook Kim, Yongkweon Jeon
abstract: Group-wise quantization is an effective strategy for mitigating accuracy degradation in low-bit quantization of large language models (LLMs). Among existing methods, GPTQ has been widely adopted due to its efficiency; however, it neglects input statistics and inter-group correlations when determining group scales, leading to a mismatch with its goal of minimizing layer-wise reconstruction loss. In this work, we propose a two-stage optimization framework for group scales that explicitly minimizes the layer-wise reconstruction loss. In the first stage, performed prior to GPTQ, we initialize each group scale to minimize the group-wise reconstruction loss, thereby incorporating input statistics. In the second stage, we freeze the integer weights obtained via GPTQ and refine the group scales to minimize the layer-wise reconstruction loss. To this end, we employ the coordinate descent algorithm and derive a closed-form update rule, which enables efficient refinement without costly numerical optimization. Notably, our derivation incorporates the quantization errors from preceding layers to prevent error accumulation. Experimental results demonstrate that our method consistently enhances group-wise quantization, achieving higher accuracy with negligible overhead.

title: Eliminating Registration Bias in Synthetic CT Generation: A Physics-Based Simulation Framework
authors: Lukas Zimmermann, Michael Rauter, Maximilian Schmid, Dietmar Georg, Barbara Knäusl
abstract: Supervised synthetic CT generation from CBCT requires registered training pairs, yet perfect registration between separately acquired scans remains unattainable. This registration bias propagates into trained models and corrupts standard evaluation metrics. This may suggest that superior benchmark performance indicates better reproduction of registration artifacts rather than anatomical fidelity. We propose physics-based CBCT simulation to provide geometrically aligned training pairs by construction, combined with evaluation using geometric alignment metrics against input CBCT rather than biased ground truth. On two independent pelvic datasets, models trained on synthetic data achieved superior geometric alignment (Normalized Mutual Information: 0.31 vs 0.22) despite lower conventional intensity scores. Intensity metrics showed inverted correlations with clinical assessment for deformably registered data, while Normalized Mutual Information consistently predicted observer preference across registration methodologies (rho = 0.31, p < 0.001). Clinical observers preferred synthetic-trained outputs in 87% of cases, demonstrating that geometric fidelity, not intensity agreement with biased ground truth, aligns with clinical requirements.

title: Scalable Spatio-Temporal SE(3) Diffusion for Long-Horizon Protein Dynamics
authors: Nima Shoghi, Yuxuan Liu, Yuning Shen, Rob Brekelmans, Pan Li, Quanquan Gu
abstract: Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations remain the gold standard for studying protein dynamics, but their computational cost limits access to biologically relevant timescales. Recent generative models have shown promise in accelerating simulations, yet they struggle with long-horizon generation due to architectural constraints, error accumulation, and inadequate modeling of spatio-temporal dynamics. We present STAR-MD (Spatio-Temporal Autoregressive Rollout for Molecular Dynamics), a scalable SE(3)-equivariant diffusion model that generates physically plausible protein trajectories over microsecond timescales. Our key innovation is a causal diffusion transformer with joint spatio-temporal attention that efficiently captures complex space-time dependencies while avoiding the memory bottlenecks of existing methods. On the standard ATLAS benchmark, STAR-MD achieves state-of-the-art performance across all metrics--substantially improving conformational coverage, structural validity, and dynamic fidelity compared to previous methods. STAR-MD successfully extrapolates to generate stable microsecond-scale trajectories where baseline methods fail catastrophically, maintaining high structural quality throughout the extended rollout. Our comprehensive evaluation reveals severe limitations in current models for long-horizon generation, while demonstrating that STAR-MD's joint spatio-temporal modeling enables robust dynamics simulation at biologically relevant timescales, paving the way for accelerated exploration of protein function.

title: There Is More to Refusal in Large Language Models than a Single Direction
authors: Faaiz Joad, Majd Hawasly, Sabri Boughorbel, Nadir Durrani, Husrev Taha Sencar
abstract: Prior work argues that refusal in large language models is mediated by a single activation-space direction, enabling effective steering and ablation. We show that this account is incomplete. Across eleven categories of refusal and non-compliance, including safety, incomplete or unsupported requests, anthropomorphization, and over-refusal, we find that these refusal behaviors correspond to geometrically distinct directions in activation space. Yet despite this diversity, linear steering along any refusal-related direction produces nearly identical refusal to over-refusal trade-offs, acting as a shared one-dimensional control knob. The primary effect of different directions is not whether the model refuses, but how it refuses.

title: Two-Stage Coded-Sliding Beam Training and QoS-Constrained Sum-Rate Maximization for SIM-Assisted Wireless Communications
authors: Qian Zhang, Ju Liu, Yao Ge, Yufei Zhao, Wali Ullah Khan, Zheng Dong, Yong Liang Guan, Chau Yuen
abstract: Stacked intelligent metasurfaces (SIM) provide a cost-effective and scalable solution for large-scale antenna communications.However, efficient channel state information acquisition and phase shift optimization remain critical challenges. In this paper, we develop a unified framework of low-complexity algorithms for SIM-assisted communication systems to address these issues. Specifically, we propose a generalized two-step codebook construction (TSCC) method that leverages two-dimensional angular-domain decoupling to transform planar array beamformer design into two independent one-dimensional linear array beamformer design problems, efficiently solved via the Gerchberg-Saxton algorithm and our proposed majorization-minimization-based proximal distance (PDMM) algorithm. We further develop a two-stage coded-sliding beam training (TSCSBT) method for low-overhead and high-accuracy beam training, where error-correcting codes are embedded in the first-stage training to enhance robustness against noise, and sliding sampling is subsequently performed around the matched angular samples to improve angular resolution. The proposed framework is further extended to multi-path user channels. Finally, a variable decoupling-based block successive upper bound minimization (VD-BSUM) algorithm is proposed to directly solve the QoS-constrained sum-rate maximization problem through closed-form iterative updates with substantially reduced computational complexity. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed methods in achieving precise beam pattern realization, improved beam training accuracy and angular resolution, and enhanced sum-rate performance.

title: Understanding the Reversal Curse Mitigation in Masked Diffusion Models through Attention and Training Dynamics
authors: Sangwoo Shin, BumJun Kim, Kyelim Lee, Moongyu Jeon, Albert No
abstract: Autoregressive language models (ARMs) suffer from the reversal curse: after learning that "$A$ is $B$", they often fail on the reverse query "$B$ is $A$". Masked diffusion-based language models (MDMs) exhibit this failure in a much weaker form, but the underlying reason has remained unclear. A common explanation attributes this mitigation to the any-order training objective. However, observing "[MASK] is $B$" during training does not necessarily teach the model to handle the reverse prompt "$B$ is [MASK]". We show that the mitigation arises from architectural structure and its interaction with training. In a one-layer Transformer encoder, weight sharing couples the two directions by making forward and reverse attention scores positively correlated. In the same setting, we further show that the corresponding gradients are aligned, so minimizing the forward loss also reduces the reverse loss. Experiments on both controlled toy tasks and large-scale diffusion language models support these mechanisms, explaining why MDMs partially overcome a failure mode that persists in strong ARMs.

title: Mitigating Safety Tax via Distribution-Grounded Refinement in Large Reasoning Models
authors: Yingsha Xie, Tiansheng Huang, Enneng Yang, Rui Min, Wenjie Lu, Xiaochun Cao, Naiqiang Tan, Li Shen
abstract: Safety alignment incurs safety tax that perturbs a large reasoning model's (LRM) general reasoning ability. Existing datasets used for safety alignment for an LRM are usually constructed by distilling safety reasoning traces and answers from an external LRM or human labeler. However, such reasoning traces and answers exhibit a distributional gap with the target LRM that needs alignment, and we conjecture such distributional gap is the culprit leading to significant degradation of reasoning ability of the target LRM. Driven by this hypothesis, we propose a safety alignment dataset construction method, dubbed DGR. DGR transforms and refines an existing out-of-distributional safety reasoning dataset to be aligned with the target's LLM inner distribution. Experimental results demonstrate that i) DGR effectively mitigates the safety tax while maintaining safety performance across all baselines, i.e., achieving \textbf{+30.2\%} on DirectRefusal and \textbf{+21.2\%} on R1-ACT improvement in average reasoning accuracy compared to Vanilla SFT; ii) the degree of reasoning degradation correlates with the extent of distribution shift, suggesting that bridging this gap is central to preserving capabilities. Furthermore, we find that safety alignment in LRMs may primarily function as a mechanism to activate latent knowledge, as a mere \textbf{10} samples are sufficient for activating effective refusal behaviors. These findings not only emphasize the importance of distributional consistency but also provide insights into the activation mechanism of safety in reasoning models.

title: $m$-Eternal Dominating Set Problem on Subclasses of Chordal Graphs
authors: Ashutosh Rai, Soumyashree Rana
abstract: A dominating set of a graph G(V, E) is a set of vertices D\subseteq V such that every vertex in V\D has a neighbor in D. An eternal dominating set extends this concept by placing mobile guards on the vertices of D. In response to an infinite sequence of attacks on unoccupied vertices, a guard can move to the attacked vertex from an adjacent position, ensuring that the new guards configuration remains a dominating set. In the one (all) guard(s) move model, only one (multiple) guard(s) moves(may move) per attack. The set of vertices representing the initial configuration of guards in one(all) guard move model is the eternal dominating set (m-eternal dominating set) of G. The minimum size of such a set in one(all) guard move model is called the eternal domination number (m-eternal domination number) of G, respectively. Given a graph G and an integer k, the m-Eternal Dominating Set asks whether G has an m-eternal dominating set of size at most k. In this work, we focus mainly on the computational complexity of m-Eternal Dominating Set in subclasses of chordal graphs. For split graphs, we show a dichotomy result by first designing a polynomial-time algorithm for K1,t-free split graphs with t\le 4, and then proving that the problem becomes NP-complete for t\ge 5. We showed that the problem is NP-hard on undirected path graphs. Moreover, we exhibit the computational complexity difference between the variants by showing the existence of two graph classes such that, in one, both Dominating Set and m-Eternal Dominating Set are solvable in polynomial time while Eternal Dominating Set is NP-hard, whereas in the other, Eternal Dominating Set is solvable in polynomial time and both Dominating Set and m-Eternal Dominating Set are NP-hard. Finally, we present a graph class where Dominating Set is NP-hard, but m-Eternal Dominating Set is efficiently solvable.

title: DCoPilot: Generative AI-Empowered Policy Adaptation for Dynamic Data Center Operations
authors: Minghao Li, Ruihang Wang, Rui Tan, Yonggang Wen
abstract: Modern data centers (DCs) hosting artificial intelligence (AI)-dedicated devices operate at high power densities with rapidly varying workloads, making minute-level adaptation essential for safe and energy-efficient operation. However, manually designing piecewise deep reinforcement learning (DRL) agents cannot keep pace with frequent dynamics shifts and service-level agreement (SLA) changes of an evolving DC. This specification-to-policy lag causes a lack of timely, effective control policies, which may lead to service outages. To bridge the gap, we present DCoPilot, a hybrid framework for generative control policies in dynamic DC operation. DCoPilot synergizes two distinct generative paradigms, i.e., a large language model (LLM) that performs symbolic generation of structured reward forms, and a hypernetwork that conducts parametric generation of policy weights. DCoPilot operates through three coordinated phases: (i) simulation scale-up, which stress-tests reward candidates across diverse simulation-ready (SimReady) scenes; (ii) meta policy distillation, where a hypernetwork is trained to output policy weights conditioned on SLA and scene embeddings; and (iii) online adaptation, enabling zero-shot policy generation in response to updated specifications. Evaluated across five control task families spanning diverse DC components, DCoPilot achieves near-zero constraint violations and outperforms all baselines across specification variations.
